title: Transient Heat Conduction on Quantum Hardware: Replicated Temperature-Field Reconstruction and Shot-Count Sensitivity with a Variational Quantum Linear Solver
summary: Implicit discretizations of transient heat conduction repeatedly generate sparse linear systems, making diffusion problems a natural test bed for quantum linear solvers. This study evaluates how accurately a variational quantum linear solver (VQLS) recovers the temperature field produced by one backward-Euler step of one-dimensional conduction on IBM quantum hardware. A pre-specified confirmatory experiment compares N=4 interior temperatures encoded on two qubits with N=8 temperatures encoded on three qubits using ten paired hardware blocks; a separately defined N=16, four-qubit extension is evaluated in five independently scheduled exploratory blocks. Local VQLS optimization reduces relative temperature-field error to approximately 10^{-8} for all three cases, establishing an essentially exact ideal reference at this scale. On hardware, mean relative L2 temperature-field error is 8.07% for N=4 and 20.14% for N=8, a paired increase of 12.06 percentage points (95% CI, 10.71-13.42; exact paired sign-flip p=0.001953). The exploratory N=16 mean is 24.75+/-1.84%. A pre-specified N=16 shot-count follow-up then evaluates the same locked circuit at 2,048, 8,192, and 32,768 shots in six independently scheduled blocks. Mean field error remains 23.64%, 24.57%, and 24.37%, respectively; the 32,768-minus-2,048-shot contrast is +0.74 percentage points (95% CI, -0.65 to 2.12; p=0.281). In contrast, ideal multinomial sampling predicts a reduction from 2.68% to 0.75%. Higher shot counts reduce block-to-block variability but do not recover the mean cold-side temperature field. The results show that full-field readout of a strongly nonuniform thermal state is limited by more than ordinary finite-shot sampling under the tested hardware conditions, motivating observable-focused quantum formulations for heat flux, stored energy, and selected temperatures.

AI.tldr: 在IBM量子硬件上用变分量子线性求解器（VQLS）求解一维瞬态热传导单步后向欧拉离散系统，理想局部优化可达~1e-8相对误差；但硬件上温度场相对L2误差随量子比特数增加由8.07%(N=4)升至20.14%(N=8)，N=16约24.75%，且提升采样次数仅降低波动而不改善均值，误差来源超出普通有限采样。
AI.motivation: 瞬态热传导的隐式离散反复产生稀疏线性系统，使扩散问题成为量子线性求解器的天然测试场景；本文旨在定量评估VQLS在真实硬件上恢复温度场的精度及其随问题规模的退化，并检验有限采样是否为误差主因。
AI.method: 采用确认性实验设计：N=4（2量子比特）与N=8（3量子比特）在10个配对硬件块上比较；另设N=16（4量子比特）探索性扩展（5个独立调度块）。理想侧用局部VQLS优化建立参考解。随后进行预设的采样数跟踪实验，对锁定的N=16电路在2,048/8,192/32,768 shots下各取6个独立块，并以精确配对符号翻转检验进行统计推断。
AI.conclusion: 强非均匀热态的全场读出精度受限于有限采样之外的硬件因素，单纯增加shots只降低块间方差而不恢复冷侧温度场均值；据此建议采用面向可观测量的量子表述（热流、储能、选定温度）而非全场重构。

title: Residual Carleman lift for nonlinear lattice Boltzmann simulations
summary: Low-order Carleman embeddings replace nonlinear dynamics by a larger linear system, but truncation errors can accumulate even when the underlying nonlinear model is accurately approximated by a quadratic equation. We construct a residual Carleman lift (RC2) of lattice Boltzmann dynamics in which an independently evolved spectral background supplies the coefficients and forcing of a second-order residual lift. In a double-shear-layer test, conventional fixed-rest Carleman reaches $87.3\%$ final error, whereas prepared RC2 achieves $0.136\%$ through vortex roll-up, without restarting the lift or using fine-reference feedback. The results demonstrate control of the finite-time accuracy of a fixed-order linear embedding through nonlinear preparation.

AI.tldr: 提出残差Carleman提升(RC2)：用独立演化的谱背景为二阶残差提升提供系数与强迫项，可在不重启提升、不使用细网格参考反馈的情况下控制固定阶线性嵌入的有限时间精度。
AI.motivation: 低阶Carleman嵌入将非线性动力学替换为更高维线性系统，但当非线性模型仅由二次方程近似时，截断误差仍会累积，传统固定阶提升难以保证有限时间精度。
AI.method: 构建格Boltzmann动力学的残差Carleman提升(RC2)；一个独立演化的谱背景为二阶残差提升提供系数和强迫项，从而以非线性"预备"方式修正提升误差。
AI.result: 在双剪切层算例中，传统固定静止Carleman最终误差达87.3%，而经预备的RC2在涡卷起过程中将误差降至0.136%。
AI.conclusion: 通过对非线性部分的预备，可有效控制固定阶线性嵌入的有限时间精度；RC2无需重启提升或使用细参考反馈即可显著降低截断误差累积。

title: SIESTA-QCOMP: Bridging Classical and Quantum Computing for Strongly Correlated Systems
summary: Density Functional Theory (DFT) is the established workhorse of computational materials science, yet it faces fundamental challenges with strongly correlated electrons, such as in transition metal complexes and bond-breaking processes. While quantum computing offers a theoretically exact path to resolve these problems, current hardware limitations prohibit fully quantum simulations of realistic material systems. To bridge this gap, we present SIESTA-QCOMP, a modular suite embedding quantum methodologies within DFT. Harnessing SIESTA's localised basis set, we implement a projection-based embedding scheme that treats the bulk environment classically while mapping the strongly correlated "impurity" subspace to a quantum processor. The architecture uses a socket-based driver to orchestrate workflows between the Fortran-based SIESTA engine and Python-based frameworks like Qiskit, ensuring high interoperability. We detail the hybrid workflow, currently utilising a Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE), and discuss the road map toward methods such as Sample-based Quantum Diagonalisation (SQD). We illustrate the framework on an hypothetical iron porphyrin calculation and argue that such hybrid architectures are not merely interim solutions but essential foundations for integrating quantum utility into materials design, as envisioned by our broader QCOMP4DFT initiative.

AI.tldr: 提出SIESTA-QCOMP模块化框架，将量子算法以投影嵌入方式嵌入SIESTA的DFT计算中，实现经典-量子混合的强关联体系模拟。
AI.motivation: DFT在处理强关联电子体系（过渡金属配合物、键断裂过程）时存在根本性困难，而纯量子模拟受当前硬件限制无法处理真实材料体系，需要混合架构弥合差距。
AI.method: 基于SIESTA的局域基组实现投影嵌入方案：环境部分经典处理，强关联"杂质"子空间映射至量子处理器；采用基于socket的驱动协调Fortran编写的SIESTA引擎与Qiskit等Python框架的工作流，当前使用VQE，并规划扩展至SQD等方法。
AI.result: 详细描述了混合工作流，并以一个假想的铁卟啉计算为例演示了该框架的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 此类混合架构并非临时过渡方案，而是将量子实用性融入材料设计的必要基础，服务于QCOMP4DFT倡议的愿景。

title: Second-Order Correction for Statistical Bias in Monte Carlo Depletion Calculations
summary: Depletion analyses are often driven by Monte Carlo neutron transport methods that introduce uncertainty into the transmutation matrix used to evolve a material composition. The nonlinearity of the matrix exponential applied to this transmutation matrix causes the uncertainty to introduce a systematic bias in the computed isotope vectors. This work derives a second-order correction for this bias that can be computed with quantities obtainable from typical Monte Carlo transport routines. An augmented Bateman system is formulated to evaluate these quantities and an adapted Chebyshev rational approximation method uses transmutation matrix factorizations for efficient evaluation of the second-order correction. Then, the correction is demonstrated using a ten-nuclide verification problem, an ITER port-plug activation problem, and a 9-pin boiling water reactor lattice containing self-shielded gadolinium-bearing fuel.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Monte Carlo中子输运给出的嬗变矩阵不确定性在矩阵指数非线性作用下引起同位素向量系统性偏差的问题，推导了可用常规MC输运算量计算的二阶偏差修正，并构建增广Bateman系统与改进的Chebyshev有理逼近法高效求值，通过三个算例验证了修正效果。
AI.motivation: 燃耗/活化分析常由Monte Carlo中子输运驱动，其引入的嬗变矩阵不确定性经矩阵指数非线性放大后，会在计算的同位素向量中产生系统性偏差，而非仅为随机误差，需要显式修正。
AI.method: 推导该偏差的二阶修正项，使其可由典型Monte Carlo输运流程可获得的统计量计算；构造增广Bateman系统以评估所需量；采用适配的Chebyshev有理逼近法（CRAM），利用嬗变矩阵分解实现二阶修正的高效求值。
AI.result: 在十核素验证问题、ITER port-plug活化问题以及含自屏蔽钆燃料的9棒沸水堆栅元三个算例中演示了该修正的应用与效果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的二阶偏差修正可在不改变现有MC输运统计量的前提下，系统性地消除由嬗变矩阵不确定性经矩阵指数非线性传播导致的同位素组成偏差，且基于增广Bateman系统与CRAM分解的算法具备计算可行性。

title: Micrometer-thin liquid sheets from single-jet impact on a sharp edge for multi-kHz laser-plasma experiments
summary: We present a simple and robust method for generating freely suspended liquid sheets by directing a single laminar liquid jet onto the sharp edge of an inclined plate. By optimizing liquid composition, impact geometry, and flow conditions, we identify a 60:40 ethylene-glycol-deionized-water volumetric mixture for stable sheet formation. The resulting sheets span 8 mm in height and 3 mm in width, with thicknesses from 1.1 to 4.8 micrometers measured by spatial and spectral interferometry. Operated in vacuum as continuously renewed plasma mirrors, these targets demonstrate stable performance from 0.5 to 10 kHz using 175-fs Yb:KGW laser pulses, reaching a maximum S-polarized reflectivity of 66.5% at an intensity of 4 x 10^14 W/cm^2. At higher intensities using 25-fs Ti:sapphire pulses at 1 kHz, maximum S-polarized reflectivity reaches 77% at 2 x 10^16 W/cm^2. The reflected beam exhibits high temporal stability, with angular pointing fluctuations of 18.19 +/- 0.53 microradians. Our results demonstrate a tunable, continuously renewed liquid-sheet target for multi-kHz laser-plasma experiments.

AI.tldr: 提出用单层流液体射流撞击倾斜板锐边产生自由悬浮液膜的方法，获得8 mm×3 mm、厚度1.1–4.8 μm的稳定液膜，作为真空中连续更新的等离子体镜，在0.5–10 kHz下稳定运行。
AI.motivation: 为多kHz激光-等离子体实验提供可连续更新、可调谐的靶材，避免固体靶的碎片与不可再生问题，并实现自由悬浮（无衬底）液膜靶。
AI.method: 将单条层流液体射流导向倾斜板的锐利边缘以展开成自由悬浮液膜；优化液体配比（乙二醇:去离子水=60:40 体积比）、撞击几何与流动条件；用空间与光谱干涉法测量膜厚；在真空中以175 fs Yb:KGW（0.5–10 kHz）和25 fs Ti:sapphire（1 kHz）脉冲测试其作为等离子体镜的反射性能与指向稳定性。
AI.result: 液膜高8 mm、宽3 mm，厚度1.1–4.8 μm；175 fs、4×10^14 W/cm^2下S偏振反射率最高66.5%，0.5–10 kHz稳定；25 fs、2×10^16 W/cm^2下最高77%；反射光束角指向抖动18.19±0.53 μrad，时间稳定性高。
AI.conclusion: 该液膜靶结构简单、鲁棒、可调谐且连续更新，适用于multi-kHz激光-等离子体实验中的等离子体镜应用。

title: Microcomb spectral fingerprinting enables parts-per-trillion methane detection with low humidity cross-sensitivity
summary: Optical frequency combs have transformed molecular spectroscopy by enabling broadband, high-resolution analysis, yet they are conventionally used as light sources to interrogate external samples. Here, we introduce an integrated microcomb sensing architecture that unifies resonantly enhanced evanescent sensing with multiwavelength molecular fingerprinting in a single ultrahigh-quality-factor silica microresonator. Gaseous analytes interact directly with the evanescent field of light recirculating within the resonator, enhancing sensitivity while encoding analyte-induced perturbations across the microcomb's collective spectral response. Rather than relying on a single optical resonance, we exploit distributed responses across multiple comb lines to generate multidimensional molecular fingerprints. Adding more comb lines systematically improves analyte discrimination, showing that the microcomb provides sensing information beyond what individual spectral channels offer. Using methane as a model analyte, we achieve an estimated detection limit of 178 parts per trillion, with minimal spectral responses to ammonia, carbon monoxide, hexane, and water vapor at relative humidities up to 90%. By replacing physically long interaction paths with resonant light recirculation in an ultrahigh-Q microresonator, this architecture brings compact optical sensing into the parts-per-trillion regime while exploiting distributed spectral information for chemical identification.

AI.tldr: 提出一种集成微梳传感架构，将共振增强倏逝场传感与多波长分子指纹识别统一于单一超高Q值二氧化硅微谐振腔中，利用分布梳线响应生成多维指纹，实现对甲烷178 ppt的探测极限。
AI.motivation: 传统光频梳多作为外部光源去探测样品，需长相干作用路径，体积大且灵敏度受限；作者希望把光频梳本身直接作为传感元件，用谐振腔内循环光替代物理长路径，实现紧凑化的ppt级气体传感。
AI.method: 在超高Q值二氧化硅微谐振腔中产生微梳，气体分析物直接与腔内再循环光的倏逝场相互作用；不依赖单一共振峰，而是利用多条梳线在频域上的分布式响应构建多维分子指纹，并系统增加梳线数目以提升判别能力。以甲烷为模型分析物，考察氨、一氧化碳、己烷及水蒸气的交叉响应。
AI.result: 甲烷探测极限估计为178 ppt；对氨、一氧化碳、己烷以及相对湿度高达90%的水蒸气表现出极小光谱响应，即高选择性；增加梳线数目可系统性改善分析物判别性能，证明微梳提供的信息超出单个光谱通道。
AI.conclusion: 用超高Q微腔中的共振光再循环替代物理长作用路径，可将紧凑型光学气体传感推进到ppt量级，同时借助分布式光谱信息实现化学识别，展示了微梳作为一体化传感平台而非仅光源的潜力。

title: From Classical Trapping to Curvature-Induced Bolus Formation in Peristaltic Wave-Driven Flows
comment: 23 pages, 17 figures. Submitted to Physical Review Fluids
summary: Bolus formation is one of the most distinctive features of peristaltic transport, yet the mechanisms governing its development remain incompletely understood. In this work, axisymmetric peristaltic-wave-driven flows under zero-pressure-gradient conditions are investigated using a high-fidelity lattice Boltzmann framework over a broad range of wave amplitudes, wavelengths, and Reynolds numbers spanning the Stokes limit to Re=100. In the Stokes limit, bolus formation is governed by the classical trapping mechanism and exhibits a remarkable wavelength-normalized similarity, with both bolus morphology and transport characteristics approaching common asymptotic behaviors as the wavelength increases. As fluid inertia becomes significant, this similarity progressively breaks down and wavelength-dependent trapping behavior emerges. In the short-wavelength regime, the pronounced geometric bending of the wave reorganizes the local flow structure and produces a distinct off-axis bolus associated with a curvature-induced trapping mechanism. The influence of this mechanism expands toward longer wavelengths with increasing Reynolds number and occupies an increasingly large portion of the parameter space considered in the present study. The results reveal that bolus formation cannot be described by a single universal mechanism. Instead, the observed trapping behavior arises from the competition between classical trapping and curvature-induced trapping, whose relative importance is controlled by wavelength, wave amplitude, and Reynolds number. These findings establish a unified physical framework for understanding bolus formation and transport in peristaltic-wave-driven flows.

AI.tldr: 采用高保真格子玻尔兹曼方法系统研究轴对称蠕动波驱动流中的bolus形成，揭示其由经典捕获与曲率致捕获两种机制竞争控制。
AI.motivation: bolus形成是蠕动输运最具特征的现象之一，但其形成机制尚不完全清楚，缺乏统一的物理解释框架。
AI.method: 在零压力梯度条件下，用高保真格子玻尔兹曼框架模拟轴对称蠕动波驱动流，覆盖从Stokes极限到Re=100的广泛波幅、波长与雷诺数参数空间。
AI.result: Stokes极限下bolus形成遵循经典捕获机制，并呈现显著的波长归一化相似性，随波长增大形貌与输运特性趋于共同渐近行为；惯性增强后相似性逐渐破坏并出现波长依赖的捕获。短波长区波动几何弯曲重组局部流动结构，产生与曲率致捕获机制相关的离轴bolus，且该机制影响范围随Re增大向长波长扩展。
AI.conclusion: bolus形成无法由单一普适机制描述，而是经典捕获与曲率致捕获竞争的结果，其相对重要性由波长、波幅和雷诺数控制，由此建立了统一的物理框架。

title: A large nonmagnetic aluminum-and-Viton vacuum chamber suitable for vacuum pressures down into the extremely-high-vacuum (XHV) regime
summary: A recently constructed large nonmagnetic vacuum chamber is described and characterized. The vacuum chamber was machined from 19-inch cubes of aluminum and are sealed using dual Viton O-rings (with the interspace between the O-rings evacuated by a separate vacuum pump). 17-inch-diameter openings on all six sides allow for easy access to the experimental apparatus and for vacuum pumps with very large pumping speeds. These 17-inch holes were bored straight through the aluminum cube, resulting in an interior volume of 100 L (almost 90\% of the total volume of the 19-inch cube). The 17-inch openings are sealed with 19-inch-diameter aluminum flanges. The system is modular in that the cubes can be connected to one another to form larger vacuum systems. The chamber is designed to allow for vacuum pressures of $10^{-12}$ torr. In many respects (including nonmagnetic properties, outgassing rate after low-temperature baking, weight, cost, ease of machining, and ease of baking due to the chamber's high thermal conductivity) this system is superior to standard stainless-steel metal-sealed CF vacuum systems and is highly recommended for use by others.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍并表征了一种新构建的大型无磁真空腔，由19英寸铝立方体加工、双重Viton O型圈密封，内部容积达100 L，目标压强可达10^-12 torr，在无磁性、放气率、重量、成本与易加工性等方面优于不锈钢CF系统。
AI.motivation: 常规不锈钢金属密封CF真空系统在无磁性、重量、成本、加工与烘烤便利性等方面存在不足，作者希望构建并验证一种更优的大型无磁真空腔方案。
AI.method: 采用19英寸铝立方体机加工腔体，六面开通17英寸直通孔以获得100 L内容积，用19英寸铝法兰密封；密封采用双重Viton O型圈，并在两道O型圈间隙单独抽真空；模块化设计可多腔拼接；通过低温烘烤后评估放气率，设计目标压强为10^-12 torr。
AI.result: 腔体内腔容积约为100 L（约为19英寸立方体总体积的90%）；系统具备模块化扩展能力并设计可达到10^-12 torr的真空压强；在无磁性质、低温烘烤后放气率、重量、成本、加工与烘烤便利性（得益于铝的高导热性）等方面均优于标准不锈钢金属密封CF真空系统。
AI.conclusion: 该铝制双重O型圈密封真空腔在多项关键指标上优于传统不锈钢CF系统，作者强烈推荐他人采用。

title: Polarization-dependent exchange effects in intrabeam scattering
summary: The emittance growth due to intrabeam scattering (IBS) depends on the scattering cross section and is therefore affected by the exchange interaction of identical particles. However, as the IBS growth rates are typically dominated by small-angle scattering events and the exchange interaction only significantly alters the cross section at relatively large angles, the influence of the exchange interaction is usually small. In this paper, we calculate the small corrections to the growth rates resulting from the exchange interaction. We include the polarization dependence of the exchange term in the cross section, and so we also present the growth rates as a function of the beam polarization.

AI.tldr: 本文计算了交换相互作用对束内散射（IBS）增长率的微小修正，给出包含自旋极化依赖的交换截面，并以极化度函数形式给出增长率。
AI.motivation: IBS引起的发射度增长依赖散射截面，因此受全同粒子交换相互作用影响；但由于IBS增长率主要由小角散射支配，而交换作用仅在较大角度显著改变截面，故其影响通常较小，需定量评估这一修正。
AI.method: 基于散射理论，在截面的交换项中引入极化依赖性，推导交换相互作用对IBS增长率的小量修正项。
AI.result: 得到交换相互作用引起的增长率微小修正；增长率可表示为束流极化度的函数，体现极化对交换截面的影响。
AI.conclusion: 交换相互作用对IBS增长率的贡献总体较小，但在考虑束流极化时其修正不可忽略，可纳入极化束的IBS建模。

title: Generative marginal learning for finite-size molecular simulation with application to stress calculation
summary: We propose generative marginal learning (GML), a framework for equilibrium sampling and local observable estimation in molecular simulations. By training a conditional diffusion model on large-system simulations, GML learns the marginal distribution of a retained region, enabling configuration generation without explicitly simulating the surrounding environment or imposing periodic boundary conditions on the retained region. We derive a marginal effective potential and the associated conditional mean-force identity, which provide the basis for both denoising and force-alignment training. As an application, we estimate the spatially averaged Irving--Kirkwood stress near a vacancy defect. Numerical results demonstrate that GML substantially improves pair structure and local stress accuracy compared with small periodic molecular dynamics simulations, mitigating finite-size effects in calculating local molecular observables.

AI.tldr: 提出生成边缘学习（GML）框架：对大系统模拟训练条件扩散模型，学习保留区域的边缘分布，无需显式模拟环境或施加周期边界，实现平衡采样与局部可观测估计。
AI.motivation: 分子模拟中，考察局部区域（如缺陷附近）时常用小尺寸周期分子动力学，会引入有限尺寸效应，使局部可观测量（如应力）不准确。希望在不模拟周围环境的前提下正确获得保留区域的平衡分布。
AI.method: 在大系统模拟数据上训练条件扩散模型，学习保留区域的边缘分布；推导边缘有效势及相应的条件平均力恒等式，作为去噪训练与力对齐训练的基础；用该框架生成构型并估计空间平均的Irving–Kirkwood应力。
AI.result: 在空位缺陷附近估计空间平均Irving–Kirkwood应力，GML在配对结构和局部应力精度上明显优于小尺寸周期MD，缓解了计算局部分子可观测量的有限尺寸效应。
AI.conclusion: GML通过边缘扩散生成替代显式环境模拟与周期边界，为局部平衡采样与局部可观测量估计提供有效途径，可减轻有限尺寸效应。

title: Reconstruction of Unobserved Core Electron Density in Tokamak Plasmas with a Neural Operator Transport Surrogate and Uncertainty Quantification
summary: Real-time control of tokamak plasmas requires the electron density profile. However, in a reactor-relevant device, diagnostic port access is limited and the profile can be observed only partially. In the present work we reconstruct the density profile by inferring the coefficients of a physics-based one-dimensional particle transport equation, using a Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) surrogate of the transport solver as a fast differentiable forward model. The surrogate enables realtime-compatible gradient-based reconstruction and uncertainty quantification from the reflectometry and interferometry measurements. We compare four uncertainty quantification methods - multi-seed ensembles, the Laplace approximation, Metropolis-Hastings, and a Gaussian method independent of the reconstruction fit. The resulting uncertainty is scored with CRPS and coverage calibration, separately on the observed and unobserved regions. We further demonstrate advantage of our approach over standard analytical function fit on synthetic and experimental DIII-D discharges.

AI.tldr: 本文利用FNO代理的输运方程作为可微前向模型，实现托卡马克电子密度剖面的实时重建与不确定量化，并优于解析函数拟合。
AI.motivation: 反应堆级托卡马克诊断端口受限，密度剖面只能被部分观测，难以实现可靠的实时重建。
AI.method: 以FNO代理的1D粒子输运求解器为快速可微前向模型，反演输运方程系数来重建密度剖面；从反射计与干涉仪测量中进行基于梯度的重建，并比较四种不确定量化方法（多种子集成、Laplace近似、Metropolis-Hastings、与重建拟合无关的高斯方法），以CRPS和覆盖率校准在观测区与非观测区分别评分。
AI.result: 在合成数据与DIII-D实验放电上，所提方法在重建性能上优于标准解析函数拟合，并给出实时兼容的不确定度估计。
AI.conclusion: 物理约束的可微代理结合梯度反演，可为部分观测下的密度剖面提供实时、带不确定度的重建方案。

title: Freeform gradient-index media reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing a gradient-index (GRIN) medium consists of determining a spatial refractive index distribution that produces a prescribed ray trajectory, an inverse problem in geometrical optics. Previous approaches have used geometrical symmetries and conserved ray quantities to address this inverse problem. Extending reconstruction to freeform media requires approaches that do not rely on these symmetries. Here, we present a three-dimensional point-wise method for reconstructing freeform GRIN media through the inverse application of local refraction. The method does not require geometrical symmetry, paraxial approximations, or prior knowledge of the iso-indicial surfaces, and is straightforward to implement. Reconstruction using two interface geometries demonstrates that different refractive index distributions can be obtained from the same prescribed trajectory function. The choice of interfaces thus provides an additional degree of freedom for optical design, subject to local refraction conditions and compatibility between overlapping reconstructed regions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需几何对称性的三维逐点自由曲面GRIN介质重建方法，通过对局部折射的逆应用由给定光线轨迹反求折射率分布。
AI.motivation: GRIN介质重建是几何光学中的逆问题：需由指定光线轨迹确定空间折射率分布。既有方法依赖几何对称性与守恒光线量，难以推广到自由曲面介质，因此需要不依赖对称性的重建途径。
AI.method: 三维逐点(piece-wise/point-wise)重建：在每个局部点对折射定律做逆运算，由轨迹的局部方向变化推断折射率梯度；不依赖几何对称、近轴近似或等折射率面先验，实现简单。
AI.result: 以两种界面几何进行重建验证，表明同一指定轨迹函数可对应不同的折射率分布；界面选择因而成为光学设计的额外自由度，但受局部折射条件及重叠重建区域相容性约束。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为自由曲面GRIN介质的逆设计提供了通用、易实现的工具，把界面几何作为新增设计自由度，其可行域由局部折射条件与区域重叠一致性共同界定。

title: A consistent coupled level-set and volume-of-fluid solver for two-phase flow in OpenFOAM
summary: Coupled level-set and volume-of-fluid methods combine the mass conservation of a transported volume fraction with the smooth interface description of a signed-distance function. In the simple coupled variant, the level set is rebuilt from the volume fraction during every time step rather than transported, and it supplies the interface curvature and the fluid properties. This paper presents an implementation of the simple coupled method in OpenFOAM and sets out four conditions that such an implementation must satisfy to stay consistent. The density in the time derivative and in the convective mass flux of the momentum equation must be the same field, the curvature in the surface tension force must come from the level set, the blended kinematic viscosity must reproduce the blended dynamic viscosity, and the smoothed fields must be evaluated on boundary and processor patches as well as in the cells. The solver is tested on the second two-dimensional rising-bubble case of Hysing et al. on two meshes. Up to t= 1.75 s, while the three reference codes of that benchmark agree, the rise velocity differs from the reference by at most 0.0064 and 0.0073 m/s on the two meshes, and its first maximum is 1.3% and 2.0% below the reference. These differences grow slightly with refinement. The same happens when the curvature and the properties are taken from the volume fraction, which reproduces the standard OpenFOAM solver, so their cause lies outside the coupling. Over the same interval the level-set coupling stays closer to the reference than this volume-fraction coupling, with a largest velocity difference of 0.0073 against 0.0094 m/s on the finer mesh. The bubble volume is conserved to the printed precision, and a run on four processors matches the serial run. The solver is released under the GNU General Public License.

AI.tldr: 本文在OpenFOAM中实现了一种简单的level-set/volume-of-fluid耦合方法，提出保持一致性必须满足的四项条件，并在Hysing二维上升气泡基准上验证，结果与参考解偏差很小、气泡体积守恒、并行与串行一致。
AI.motivation: simple coupled方法兼具VOF的质量守恒与level-set的平滑界面描述，但需要一个与该方法严格一致的具体实现；作者希望给出OpenFOAM实现并阐明该实现保持一致性的必要条件。
AI.method: 在OpenFOAM中实现simple coupled方法：level set每步由体积分数重建而非输运，并由其提供界面曲率与流体物性。提出四项一致性条件：动量方程时间导数与对流通量中的密度须为同一场；表面张力中的曲率须来自level set；混合运动粘度须能重现混合动力粘度；平滑场须在边界与处理器patch上以及网格单元内均求值。在Hysing二维上升气泡算例的两种网格上测试。
AI.result: 至t=1.75 s，三种参考代码结果一致，本解法上升速度最大偏差为0.0064与0.0073 m/s（两种网格），首个峰值低于参考1.3%与2.0%，且偏差随网格加密略增；改用体积分数提供曲率与物性（即复现标准OpenFOAM求解器）时现象相同，说明原因在耦合之外。该区间内level-set耦合比体积分数耦合更接近参考（细网格最大速度偏差0.0073对0.0094 m/s）。气泡体积在打印精度内守恒，四进程并行算例与串行一致。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的simple coupled方法实现满足四项一致性条件，可实现质量守恒、界面平滑与并行一致性，并在基准算例上优于体积分数耦合；求解器以GNU通用公共许可证发布。

title: Hidden Perturbative Structure in Attosecond Streaking
summary: Attosecond streaking is inherently multiphoton, yet we uncover a hidden perturbative structure revealing the underlying continuum--continuum angular-momentum propensity. By filtering the inversion-odd response in helium streaking data at the IR fundamental, we isolate an angular distribution dominated by the $P_1$ and $P_3$ Legendre components, whose complex coefficients yield an effective $s/d$ two-photon amplitude ratio. Multichannel, two-electron time-dependent Schrödinger equation calculations demonstrate that the characteristic Fano propensity survives electron correlation. Incorporating the experimental XUV attochirp reproduces the measured emission-edge trend, while near-threshold calculations predict resonant amplitude and phase signatures associated with the bound He $np$ Rydberg series. This symmetry- and frequency-filtering approach offers a general spectroscopic framework with potential applications to atomic, molecular, and solid-state systems where attosecond streaking is established.

AI.tldr: 该文从氦原子阿秒条纹（streaking）数据中提取出隐藏的微扰结构，分离出由P1与P3勒让德分量主导的角分布，获得有效的s/d双光子振幅比，揭示连续态-连续态角动量倾向性（Fano propensity）。
AI.motivation: 阿秒条纹过程本质上是多光子过程，通常被视为非微扰，缺乏直观的角动量选择定则图像；作者希望找到其中隐含的微扰结构，从而把条纹测量转化为可解释的角动量分辨谱学工具。
AI.method: 对红外基频下的氦条纹数据进行反演奇（inversion-odd）响应滤波，按对称性与频率筛选，提取角分布中P1、P3勒让德分量的复系数；开展多通道双电子含时薛定谔方程（TDSE）计算；并在计算中引入实验XUV attochirp，另做近阈值计算。
AI.result: 滤波后角分布确由P1与P3分量主导，其复系数给出有效s/d双光子振幅比；TDSE表明特征性Fano倾向在电子关联下依然保留；引入XUV attochirp后可重现实测发射边趋势；近阈值计算预测出与He np里德伯系列相关的共振振幅与相位特征。
AI.conclusion: 对称性与频率滤波方法可从多光子条纹信号中提取连续态-连续态角动量倾向信息，构成一种通用谱学框架，可推广至已建立阿秒条纹技术的原子、分子与固态体系。

title: Scaling laws for contamination traversal times during vacuum breaks in superconducting accelerators
summary: A sudden loss of vacuum in a superconducting radio-frequency (SRF) accelerator drives warm gas into the evacuated beamline, where it propagates through interconnected SRF cavities cooled by liquid helium, causing surface contamination, intense heat deposition, and dangerous pressure buildup. Yet predicting how such a failure propagates through realistic multicell cavities has remained difficult because compressible gas dynamics, condensation and cryogenic heat transfer are strongly coupled. Here we develop and experimentally validate a multidimensional computational framework that resolves these processes, and apply it to a full-scale nine-cell SRF cavity. We find that the repeated cell geometry produces staircase-like gas-front propagation, as impingement, recirculation and localized cryopumping strongly retard the bulk flow within each cell. Across a broad range of breach sizes, the cavity traversal time follows a robust power-law scaling with leakage area, providing quantitative guidance for the response time of beamline isolation and protection systems. The simulations also reveal a geometry-confined Mach disk whose position and size track the advancing gas front, suggesting that its acoustic emission could potentially enable rapid, non-invasive detection and localization of vacuum failures. These findings pave the way for a new generation of predictive diagnostics and protection strategies to safeguard large-scale superconducting accelerators.

AI.tldr: 该文建立了可实验验证的多维计算框架，耦合可压缩气体动力学、凝结与低温传热，模拟真空失效在九腔SRF腔中的传播，发现阶梯式气锋传播、横扫时间随泄漏面积的幂律标度以及几何受限马赫盘。
AI.motivation: 超导射频加速器突发失真空会把暖气体带入束流管，在多腔间传播造成表面污染、剧烈热沉积与危险压力累积，但可压缩流动、凝结与低温传热强耦合，使现实多腔结构中的失效传播难以预测，因此缺乏隔离与保护系统响应时间的定量依据。
AI.method: 发展并实验验证一个解析上述耦合过程的多维计算框架，并将其应用于全尺寸九腔SRF腔；考察击穿尺寸范围，分析气锋传播形态、腔体 atravessal 时间对泄漏面积的依赖，以及马赫盘结构特征。
AI.result: 重复腔胞几何导致阶梯状气锋传播：每腔内撞击、回流与局部低温抽吸显著阻滞主流；在较宽击穿尺寸范围内，腔体横扫时间与泄漏面积呈稳健幂律标度；模拟揭示位置与尺寸随气锋推进的几何受限马赫盘。
AI.conclusion: 结果为束流管隔离与保护系统的响应时间提供定量指导，并提示马赫盘声发射可用于快速、非侵入式真空失效检测与定位，为大型超导加速器的预测性诊断与防护策略奠定基础。

title: Multigroup Implicit Monte Carlo Radiation Hydrodynamics on Moving Voronoi Meshes with STORM and RICH
comment: See STORM's paper at https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20639. This paper has been submitted to ApJS in October 2026. Comments are welcome and appreciated: maormiz@cs.huji.ac.il
summary: We present and validate an Implicit Monte Carlo (IMC) radiation-transport solver in the open-source, mesh-agnostic storm library, coupled to the moving-mesh hydrodynamics code rich in three-dimensional Voronoi tessellations. The solver is multigroup, or continuous in frequency, throughout; it transforms photon packets exactly between the comoving and laboratory frames, books every exchange with the material as a laboratory four-momentum so that the IMC path conserves energy to roundoff, formulates the Fleck factor in the fluid's proper time, and accelerates optically thick cells with multigroup Discrete Diffusion Monte Carlo (DDMC) behind an emissivity-preserving interface. We tested the solver on a broad suite of benchmark problems, and it performed well on all of them. The solver is built on the MPI-parallel Monte Carlo framework of storm, which scales to 13,440 cores.

AI.tldr: 在开源、网格无关的storm库中实现并验证了隐式蒙特卡罗(IMC)辐射输运求解器，与基于三维Voronoi镶嵌的rich移动网格流体动力学代码耦合，采用多群/连续频率、共动系与实验室系间光子包精确变换、以实验室四动量记账保证能量守恒、按流体固有时间构造Fleck因子，并以多群DDMC加速光学厚区；在广泛基准问题上表现良好，MPI并行可扩展至13,440核。
AI.motivation: 需要一个能与移动网格（Voronoi镶嵌）流体动力学耦合、网格无关且能量守恒的辐射输运求解器，以支撑多物理、多群辐射流体模拟。
AI.method: 在storm库中构建IMC求解器：(1) 多群或连续频率处理；(2) 光子包在共动系与实验室系间精确变换；(3) 每次与物质交换以实验室四动量记账，使IMC路径能量守恒至舍入误差；(4) 在流体固有时间中构造Fleck因子；(5) 光学厚单元采用多群Discrete Diffusion Monte Carlo (DDMC)，并设保发射率界面；(6) 基于storm的MPI并行蒙特卡罗框架。
AI.result: 在一整套广泛基准问题（benchmark problems）上测试，全部表现良好；求解器在高性能计算上可扩展至13,440核。
AI.conclusion: 该IMC求解器与移动网格流体动力学代码的耦合方案可行且稳健，具备能量守恒、多群能力与良好并行扩展性，适用于大规模辐射流体模拟。

title: One Component Plasmas Frequency Moments from the ISF
summary: Dynamic structural characteristics of classical one component plasmas (OCP) are an essential tool for understanding of strongly coupled plasmas through experiments and numerical simulations. Here, instead of the dynamic structure factor, we focus our attention on the intermediate scattering function (ISF). Theoretical results are compared to those of obtained by the method of molecular dynamics (MD).

AI.tldr: 本文转向研究经典单组分等离子体(OCP)的中间散射函数(ISF)，并将理论结果与分子动力学(MD)模拟结果进行对比。
AI.motivation: 动态结构特性是理解强耦合等离子体的关键工具，但以往研究多集中于动态结构因子，作者希望从中间散射函数这一角度切入。
AI.method: 以经典单组分等离子体(OCP)为对象，解析/理论计算其中间散射函数(ISF)，并与分子动力学(MD)模拟所得结果进行比较验证。
AI.result: 理论结果与MD模拟结果进行了对比（摘要未给出具体数值结论）。
AI.conclusion: 中间散射函数可作为刻画强耦合等离子体动态结构的有用切入点，理论方法与MD模拟具有可比性。

title: Charge-Selective Displacement of Spatiotemporal Optical Vortices at a Spatially Uniform Time Boundary
summary: At a spatially uniform, in-plane-isotropic time boundary, the transverse displacement of a spatiotemporal optical vortex changes sign with its topological charge, despite a charge-independent conversion weight. Radial spectral filtering couples to the vortex phase while preserving identical converted spectral intensities for opposite charges. For a narrow scalar Gaussian spectrum, the displacement follows the logarithmic slope of the spectral weight and occurs with zero mean transverse momentum. In a finite pumped GaAs waveguide, unequal attenuation during extraction adds angular deflection. Independent Maxwell--Drude simulations test this extraction-induced response and give $\pm42$~mrad before detector filtering. Calculated centroid traces at multiple planes separate propagation-induced drift from position offsets.

AI.tldr: 研究时空光涡旋（STOV）经空间均匀、面内各向同性时间边界时的横向位移规律，并区分传播漂移与位置偏移。
AI.motivation: 时间边界处横向位移与拓扑电荷的符号依赖、以及转换权重是否与电荷相关尚不明确；同时需把真实的提取衰减效应对位移的影响与传播引起的漂移区分开。
AI.method: 解析分析径向光谱滤波与涡旋相位的耦合（窄标量高斯谱下位移随光谱权重的对数斜率变化，且平均横向动量为零）；并用独立的Maxwell–Drude仿真考察有限泵浦GaAs波导中提取过程的不等衰减，及多平面质心轨迹计算。
AI.result: 时间边界处横向位移随拓扑电荷变号，而转换权重与电荷无关；反号电荷获得相同的转换谱强度。GaAs波导中提取期间的不等衰减引入额外角偏转，探测器滤波前为±42 mrad。
AI.conclusion: STOV在时间边界的位移由涡旋相位与光谱滤波耦合决定，符号依赖电荷；实际波导中的提取诱导角偏转需单列，多平面质心轨迹可有效分离漂移与偏移。

title: Transient growth and Counter-propagating Rossby Waves in a sloped Eady problem
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, REVTeX format; submitted to PRF, comments welcome
summary: A mechanistic interpretation for baroclinic normal mode instability with exponential growth is the interaction arising from Counter-propagating Rossby Waves (CRWs), where pairs of CRWs phase-lock and interfere constructively. On the other hand, an arbitrary initial condition can lead to finite transient growth as long as there is constructive interference. The present work investigates the characteristics of finite time transient instabilities and its description in terms of CRWs in a baroclinic system with asymmetric interaction, in contrast to usual settings where there is an inherent symmetry that leads to equal and opposite CRWs. A sloped Eady problem on a $f$-plane is considered here, which has the benefit that there are only two CRWs in the system, and the presence of a bottom topographic slope can be formulated in a such a way that only one of the CRW is affected and controlled by a single parameter representing the asymmetry, via modifying the bottom background potential vorticity gradient. We derive conditions where the instantaneous growths have key CRW properties that are independent of the asymmetry parameter for a reasonably general family of norms, and that the instability characteristic in the total energy norm is entirely independent of the asymmetry parameter. For finite time transient growth, the optimal initial condition is in some sense counter to that of the exponential growing normal mode: where the bottom slope is such that it is strengthening the bottom CRW, the normal mode has a larger bottom CRW, but the finite time optimal initial condition wants the bottom CRW to be weak instead, and vice-versa. While the results presented here are for the sloped Eady problem, the same results were also found for an analogous Phillips problem, and we speculate the instability characteristics may have origins in the underlying symmetries that are common to those two problems.

AI.tldr: 本文在含非对称相互作用的斜底Eady问题中研究有限时瞬态不稳定，并用反传播Rossby波（CRW）框架刻画，发现瞬时增长的关键CRW性质与不对称参数无关，且最优瞬态初始条件与指数增长法向模态的CRW结构相反。
AI.motivation: 经典CRW理论将斜压法向模态不稳定解释为一对CRW相锁定并相长干涉，但常规设定存在内在对称性（两CRW等幅反号）。作者希望考察两CRW相互作用不对称时，有限时瞬态增长率及其CRW刻画如何变化，从而加深对瞬态增长机制的动力学理解。
AI.method: 采用f平面上的斜底Eady问题：系统仅含两个CRW；底地形坡度通过修改底层背景位涡梯度来构造，使仅一个CRW受控，且不对称性由单一参数表示。据此推导瞬态增长率（瞬时增长率）在较一般范数族下的CRW性质，并分析总能量范数下的不稳定特征，最后在类Phillips问题中做验证性对比。
AI.result: 对相当一般的范数族，瞬时增长率的若干关键CRW性质与不对称参数无关；在总能量范数下，不稳定特征完全不依赖不对称参数。有限时瞬态最优初始条件与指数增长法向模态的振幅分配“相反”：当坡度增强底层CRW时，法向模态的底层CRW更强，而最优瞬态初始条件却要求底层CRW较弱，反之亦然。
AI.conclusion: 斜底Eady问题中瞬态不稳定可由CRW框架自洽刻画，其能量范数下的不稳定特征与不对称参数无关，且最优瞬态增长与法向模态在CRW振幅分配上呈互补/反向关系。类似结论在Phillips问题中亦成立，作者推测这些特性可能源于两类问题共有的底层对称性。

title: Large Language Model Steering of Acousto-Optic Tweezer Arrays
summary: Controlling quantum hardware requires choosing and revising experimental strategies as nonlinear response, coupling, and drift limit calibration. We experimentally investigate a general-purpose large language model (LLM) as a human-in-the-loop strategy layer for a neutral-atom tweezer platform. Through step-by-step interaction with experimental feedback, the LLM guides a transition from multiplicative row--column correction to a drift-corrected local response-matrix method when separable feedback stalls. Deterministic software performs image analysis and numerical updates, while an experimentalist verifies and authorizes each waveform. For a $10\times10$ crossed-acousto-optic-deflector array, this workflow reduces the Gaussian-peak coefficient of variation from $20.30\%$ to $1.57\%$ in 30 candidate-update rounds. The experiment demonstrates feedback-informed strategy selection on a physical quantum-control subsystem, rather than direct generation of control parameters alone. These results highlight the potential of LLMs to guide control optimization across diverse quantum platforms by adaptively formulating and refining experimental strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文实验性地将通用大语言模型（LLM）作为中性原子光镊平台的human-in-the-loop策略层，通过实验反馈自适应地选择与修订校准策略，而非直接生成控制参数。
AI.motivation: 量子硬件控制需要随非线性响应、耦合与漂移不断选择并修正实验策略；单纯依赖固定策略或直接生成控制参数难以应对可分离反馈失效的情况。
AI.method: LLM与实验逐步交互获得反馈，指导从乘性行-列校正切换到漂移校正的局部响应矩阵方法；确定性软件执行图像分析与数值更新，实验人员逐次验证并授权每个波形。在10×10交叉声光偏转器阵列上评估。
AI.result: 30轮候选更新内，高斯峰值变异系数由20.30%降至1.57%。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明了LLM在物理量子控制子系统上执行反馈驱动的策略选择能力（而非仅生成参数），显示其通过自适应构建与精炼实验策略来指导跨平台控制优化的潜力。

title: Construction of crystal-based light sources with LWFA electron beams
summary: We discuss a possibility to construct a crystal-based light source (CLS) of gamma-rays using electron beams produce by Laser Wake Field Acceleration (LWFA). This state-of-the-art acceleration technique is capable of producing few-GeV, ultra-short (fs) electron beams. In the case studies presented, we demonstrate the feasibility of novel gamma-ray CLSs based on exposing single crystals to electron beams available at the ELI-ELBA. The results of rigorous numerical simulations are presented to characterise the radiation emitted emitted by 1 and 4 GeV electrons incident on a 200-micron-thick single silicon crystal along the (110) plane. The simulations were performed using the current divergence as well as a smaller value that is believed to be a realistic to achieve in the near future. We demonstrate that it is feasible to achieve a photon yield of $10^6-10^7$ photons/s in the photon energy range from 5 to 50 MeV. Looking further ahead, we also performed a similar analysis for a 4-GeV positron beam incident on much thicker targets, up to 2 mm oriented silicon crystal. In this case, the photon yield can be increased by an order of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 探索利用LWFA电子束轰击单晶构建基于晶体辐射的γ射线光源，模拟表明可在5–50 MeV能区获得10^6–10^7 photons/s的产额，厚靶正电子情形产额可再提高一个量级。
AI.motivation: LWFA可提供GeV量级、飞秒超短电子束，为新型γ射线晶体光源（CLS）提供了理想驱动源，本文旨在评估在ELI-ELBA上构建此类光源的可行性。
AI.method: 采用严格数值模拟，计算1 GeV与4 GeV电子沿200 μm厚单晶硅(110)面入射时的辐射特性；分别采用当前束流发散度与预期可实现的更小发散度；并对4 GeV正电子入射至最厚2 mm定向硅晶体的情形作类似分析。
AI.result: 在5–50 MeV光子能区可实现10^6–10^7 photons/s的光子产额；采用更小束流发散度有利于提升性能；4 GeV正电子轰击厚定向晶体时产额可提高约一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 基于LWFA电子束与单晶的γ射线CLS在ELI-ELBA上具备可行性，正电子厚靶方案可进一步显著提升产额，为未来紧凑型高亮度γ源提供路径。

title: A Unified Interface Neural Network for Elliptic Interface Problems
summary: We develop a Unified Interface Neural Network (UINN) framework for elliptic interface problems with discontinuous coefficients. A single shared network provides a unified representation of the solution in both subdomains, while a projection--correction construction embeds the solution and flux jump conditions directly into the neural trial space. This design aligns with the classical numerical principle of incorporating interfacial physics into the approximation basis to construct interface-unfitted numerical methods. The jump conditions are therefore satisfied exactly for any network parameters. Compared with methods based on separate phase networks and numerical formulations with interface penalty terms, UINN provides a unified representation with exact enforcement of interfacial jump conditions and interface-penalty-free optimization. Those features streamline the numerical formulations and can enhance training robustness. Numerical experiments on smooth interfaces at modestly large and high coefficient contrasts demonstrate UINN's solution accuracy, near-machine-precision satisfaction of the interface jump conditions, and enhanced robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出统一界面神经网络(UINN)框架，用单个共享网络表示椭圆界面问题两个子域的解，并通过投影-校正构造将解与通量的跳跃条件精确嵌入试探空间，实现无需界面罚项、跳跃条件精确满足的界面非拟合数值方法。
AI.motivation: 椭圆界面问题(系数间断)的传统神经网络方法多采用分相独立网络或带界面罚项的数值格式，导致公式复杂、跳跃条件仅近似满足、训练稳定性受影响。作者希望借鉴经典数值思想——把界面物理嵌入逼近基以构造界面非拟合方法——从而简化公式并提升鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建UINN框架：单一共享网络对两子域解给出统一表示；采用投影-校正(projection-correction)构造，将解跳跃条件与通量跳跃条件直接嵌入神经试探空间。由于跳跃条件被构造性满足，任意网络参数下均精确成立，优化过程中无需界面罚项，也无需分相独立网络。
AI.result: 在光滑界面、中等偏大及高系数对比的数值实验中，UINN展现出良好的解的精度、接近机器精度的界面跳跃条件满足度，以及相较分相网络与罚项方法更强的训练鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将界面跳跃条件精确嵌入神经试探空间是可行且有效的：UINN以统一表示、精确跳跃条件与无罚项优化简化了数值公式并提升鲁棒性，为界面非拟合神经网络方法提供了新范式。

title: Reduced Molecular Plasma Kinetics with Non-Boltzmann Vibrational Distribution
summary: Vibrational kinetics can strongly affect energy transfer, chemical kinetics, and discharge behavior in molecular plasmas, but resolving all internal states is often impractical for reactor-scale simulation. Compact, physics-based vibrational closures are particularly needed when complete state-to-state (StS) data are limited. Starting from a detailed $\mathrm{H}_2$ StS plasma-kinetics framework coupled to an electron-Boltzmann calculation, this work develops a reduced vibrational-kinetics formulation. The $\mathrm{H}_2$ vibrational ladder is reduced to two non-Boltzmann groups that evolve their population and internal energy. State-resolved reaction rates and associated energy-exchange terms are projected onto the groups for subsequent tabulation in reactor-scale plasma models. StS-informed samples of the reduced-model are propagated for pulsed RF $\mathrm{H}_2$ plasmas across a scan of pulse-averaged absorbed power and compared with the corresponding StS simulations. Predictions from the sampled models reproduce the bulk plasma response, including electron density, atomic-H density, and $\mathrm{H}_3^+$ density. Discrepancies in $\mathrm{H}^-$ production and the upper-energy-group vibrational temperature persist across the sampled reductions. This indicates a limitation of the present VDF reconstruction rather than the nominal parameter choice. Tail-sensitive processes therefore require a more accurate representation of the vibrational distribution.

AI.tldr: 该工作将分子等离子体中的详细态-态（StS）振动动力学简化为两个非玻尔兹曼振动群，用其演化和内部能量捕捉振动动力学，并在脉冲RF H₂等离子体功率扫描中检验其保真度。
AI.motivation: 振动动力学显著影响能量传递、化学动力学与放电行为，但在反应器尺度模拟中分辨全部内态不现实；当完整StS数据有限时，尤其需要紧凑且基于物理的振动闭合模型。
AI.method: 以耦合电子玻尔兹曼计算的详细H₂ StS等离子体动力学框架为基础，将H₂振动阶梯归约为两个非玻尔兹曼群（演化布居数与内部能量）；把态分辨反应速率及相应能量交换项投影到群上以便制表；对约化模型的StS信息样本在脉冲RF H₂等离子体的脉均吸收功率扫描上进行传播，并与对应StS模拟对比。
AI.result: 采样模型的预测能重现体等离子体响应，包括电子密度、原子H密度与H₃⁺密度；但H⁻生成与高能群振动温度存在持续偏差，且该偏差在所采样的约化中均存在，表明其源于当前振动分布函数（VDF）重构的局限，而非名义参数选择。
AI.conclusion: 双群振动闭合可有效再现多数体等离子体响应，适用于反应器尺度模拟；但尾部敏感的（tail-sensitive）过程需要更准确的振动分布表征，是后续改进方向。

title: Realization of valley-controlled orbital angular momentum via inter-orbital coupling
summary: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) represents a fundamental degree of freedom (DoF) for understanding novel phenomena in solids and synthetic lattices. However, the generation and control of OAM in lattice systems remain challenging. Here, we experimentally observe valley-controlled OAM states in inversion-symmetry-broken photonic honeycomb lattices consisting of s- and higher-orbital sublattices. These OAM states manifest as chiral vortex arrays in real space. By selectively exciting s-orbital modes carrying no initial OAM at either the K or K' valley, we observe higher-orbital OAM modes generated via inter-orbital coupling in neighboring sites. Specifically, s-p orbital coupling generates OAM states with topological charge l=+1 or l=-1, while s-d orbital coupling yields higher-charge OAM states with l=+2 or l=-2. The sign of the topological charge is determined by the valley DoF, enabling deterministic control of vortex chirality across the entire array. Our theory further reveals that a local vortex-chirality symmetry enforces the valley-dependent selection of vortex chirality at the K and K' valleys, establishing a direct connection between the valley DoF and real-space vortex chirality. These results establish a versatile platform for engineering chiral vortex arrays via orbital physics and exploring orbital- and topology-mediated phenomena in photonic systems and beyond.

AI.tldr: 该文在破缺反演对称性的光子蜂窝晶格中实验观测到谷控轨道角动量(OAM)态，并证明谷自由度可确定性地调控实空间涡旋手性与拓扑荷符号。
AI.motivation: OAM是理解固体与人工晶格中新奇现象的基本自由度，但在晶格体系中OAM的产生与调控仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 构建由s轨道与高轨道子晶格组成、反演对称性破缺的光子蜂窝晶格；在K或K'谷选择性激发无初始OAM的s轨道模式，借助近邻格点间的轨道间耦合（s-p、s-d）产生OAM；并结合理论提出局域涡旋手性对称性来解释谷依赖的涡旋手性选择规则。
AI.result: OAM态在实空间表现为手性涡旋阵列；s-p耦合产生拓扑荷l=+1或−1的OAM态，s-d耦合产生l=+2或−2的高荷OAM态；拓扑荷符号由谷自由度决定，从而实现对整列涡旋手性的确定性调控。
AI.conclusion: 局域涡旋手性对称性强制K与K'谷对涡旋手性的选择性，建立了谷自由度与实空间涡旋手性之间的直接联系；该平台为基于轨道物理的手性涡旋阵列工程及轨道/拓扑介导现象研究提供了通用途径。

title: Yielding-dependent Taylor dispersion in electrokinetic-magnetohydrodynamic Casson microflows
summary: Longitudinal dispersion in a yielding fluid depends on the velocity distribution and on how the flow is maintained. We study a neutral tracer in pressure-assisted electrokinetic and magnetohydrodynamic flow of a Casson fluid through a slit microchannel. The nonlinear stress and velocity equations determine the yielded layers, the unyielded core and the axial flow. Mei's multiple-scale homogenization of the advection-diffusion equation then separates transverse relaxation, mean drift and longitudinal spreading, yielding the Taylor-Aris auxiliary problem and effective diffusivity. An exact pressure-driven solution gives cubic decay of the mean velocity and eighth-power decay of the dispersion enhancement near flow arrest. Under fixed pressure and electrical forcing, increasing the yield parameter from $Y=0$ to $0.7$ moves the optimum Hartmann number from $Ha_p=0.696$ to $2.634$, while the corresponding normalized diffusivity decreases from $D_T^{\mathrm C}=1.454$ to $1.015$. At fixed mean throughput and $Ha_p=1$, the trend reverses: $D_T^{\mathrm C}$ increases from $1.000433$ to $1.002311$. The homogenized energy identity traces this difference to the velocity departure from the sectional mean, including that within the unyielded core. Analytical limiting solutions, direct concentration calculations, numerical convergence studies and a coupled Casson shear test support the reduced-flow predictions. An electrolyte-based dimensional assessment identifies the magnetic optima as theoretical forcing states for representative aqueous microchannels. These results are relevant to predicting longitudinal tracer spreading in microchannels carrying fluids with a yield stress, whether pressure or throughput is controlled.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Casson屈服流体在压力辅助电动与磁流体动力学驱动下狭缝微通道内的中性示踪剂纵向弥散，用Mei多尺度均匀化导出有效扩散率，并揭示屈服参数与哈特曼数对最优弥散的调控及压力控制与流量控制下的相反趋势。
AI.motivation: 屈服流体的纵向弥散同时取决于速度分布与流动维持方式（压力控制或吞吐量控制），而压力辅助电动与MHD耦合驱动下Casson流体的Taylor-Aris弥散规律尚不清楚，需要定量刻画屈服层/未屈服核及磁强迫对示踪剂展布的影响。
AI.method: 建立狭缝微通道中Casson流体的非线性应力与速度方程，确定屈服层、未屈服核与轴向流动；对对流-扩散方程采用Mei多尺度均匀化，分离横向松弛、平均漂移与纵向展布，得到Taylor-Aris辅助问题与有效扩散率；给出精确压力驱动解及解析极限解，并以直接浓度计算、数值收敛性研究和耦合Casson剪切试验验证。
AI.result: 精确压力驱动解显示流速在流动停滞附近呈三次衰减、弥散增强呈八次幂衰减。固定压力与电强迫时，屈服参数由Y=0增至0.7使最优Hartmann数从Ha_p=0.696移至2.634，归一化扩散率由D_T^C=1.454降至1.015；固定平均吞吐量与Ha_p=1时趋势相反，D_T^C由1.000433升至1.002311。均匀化能量恒等式将差异归因于速度相对截面平均的偏离（含未屈服核内偏离）；基于电解液的量纲评估表明磁最优为代表性水相微通道的理论强迫状态。
AI.conclusion: 压力辅助电动与MHD驱动的Casson流体弥散受屈服参数、哈特曼数与控制方式（压力或吞吐量）共同支配，且两种控制模式下屈服效应方向相反；结果为含屈服应力流体的微通道纵向示踪剂展布预测提供依据。

title: Fast and High-Fidelity Motional-State-Preserving Transport in Optical Tweezers
summary: Reconfigurable neutral-atom processors require rapid, high-fidelity transport of atoms between optical-tweezer sites. In finite-depth Gaussian traps, fast motion can leave residual motional excitation even when the atom reaches its destination. We develop a basis-parameterized gradient-ascent pulse-engineering (GRAPE) framework for one-dimensional transport of a single $^{87}$Rb atom. A shortcut-to-adiabaticity reference is refined using 17 trajectory parameters, with ten additional parameters providing bounded trap-depth modulation; depth affects both confinement and the inverse construction of the physical trap center. For a $12.6\,μ$m transfer completed in only $30.5\,μ$s, corresponding to approximately $2.75$ periods of the reference trap, the selected joint protocol achieves a ground-state infidelity of $2.41\times10^{-7}$. Because preparing an exactly pure motional ground state is experimentally challenging, we also optimize population-weighted transport for initial distributions with mean vibrational occupations $\nbar\simeq0.16$ and $1.87$, reaching same-state probabilities of about $0.99993$ and $0.9934$. Trap-depth fluctuations can further degrade transport fidelity. Robust optimization under a measurement-informed depth-noise model improves the mean error, worst sampled error, and fidelity dispersion for the specified noise realizations. Coordinated control of tweezer position and confinement thus offers a route to rapid transport with low residual excitation for flexible atom rearrangement and dynamic connectivity in neutral-atom processors.

AI.tldr: 提出基于基参数化GRAPE的脉冲工程框架，通过联合优化光镊位置轨迹与阱深调制，实现单个87Rb原子在12.6 μm距离上约30.5 μs的快速高保真输运，基态不保真度低至2.41×10⁻⁷。
AI.motivation: 可重构中性原子处理器需要在光镊位点间快速、高保真地输运原子；有限深度的高斯阱中，快速运动即便到达目标位置也会残留振动激发，因此需要抑制残余激发。
AI.method: 构建以基函数参数化的GRAPE优化框架，用于一维单原子输运；以绝热捷径（shortcut-to-adiabaticity）轨迹为参考，用17个轨迹参数进行精化，另加10个参数实现有界阱深调制；阱深同时影响约束强度与物理阱中心的逆构造。此外，针对平均振动占据数n̄≈0.16与1.87的初始分布进行群体加权输运优化，并在测量导出的阱深噪声模型下开展鲁棒优化。
AI.result: 对2.75个参考阱周期（30.5 μs）完成12.6 μm转移，联合协议基态不保真度为2.41×10⁻⁷；n̄≈0.16与1.87时同态概率分别约0.99993和0.9934；鲁棒优化改善了指定噪声实现下的平均误差、最坏采样误差及保真度离散度。
AI.conclusion: 对光镊位置与约束强度的协同控制是实现快速、低残余激发输运的有效途径，可支撑中性原子处理器中的灵活重排与动态连接。

title: A General Treatment of Coupled Cavity Resonators
summary: Consider several cavity resonators whose resonant frequencies and electromagnetic fields are known, and suppose that they are coupled through apertures. How can the resonant frequencies and resonant electromagnetic fields of the resulting coupled-cavity resonator be expressed in terms of the original resonant frequencies and electromagnetic fields? This is a problem frequently encountered in radio-frequency systems for accelerators. One example is a multicell cavity used in high-energy electron accelerators. In this note, the resonant frequencies and resonant electromagnetic fields of such coupled cavities are examined as generally as possible, based only on Maxwell's equations and boundary conditions. Specifically, the response function of a cavity as viewed from its coupling ports, namely, its admittance matrix, is derived, and a formulation is developed to express the coupled resonant electromagnetic fields using this matrix. The resulting formulation shows that the coupled resonant modes can be described in terms of overlap integrals between the resonant modes of the cavities and the waveguide modes at the coupling apertures. It also shows that the coupled resonant frequencies are given by the zeros of the determinant of a matrix constructed from the admittance matrices. The results thus obtained are applied to simple systems to confirm the validity of the formulation. Numerical calculations based on this formulation are also carried out for periodic systems in an attempt to derive dispersion relations.

AI.tldr: 基于麦克斯韦方程组与边界条件，推导腔体从耦合口看入的导纳矩阵，并用以将耦合腔的谐振频率与场表达为各腔本征模与孔径处波导模的重叠积分；耦合频率由导纳矩阵行列式零点给出。
AI.motivation: 加速器射频系统（如高能电子加速器多腔腔体）中常遇到多个已知本征频率与场的腔体经孔径耦合的问题，需要一般性地用原腔本征量表达耦合腔的谐振频率与电磁场。
AI.method: 仅从麦克斯韦方程与边界条件出发，具有一般性地处理孔径耦合腔；推导腔体作为端口网络的响应函数（导纳矩阵），并用该矩阵建立耦合谐振场的表达式，借助腔本征模与孔径处波导模的重叠积分描述耦合模。
AI.result: 耦合谐振模可表示为各腔本征模与耦合孔径处波导模的重叠积分；耦合谐振频率由导纳矩阵构造的行列式零点确定；对简单系统验证了公式有效性，并对周期系统开展数值计算以导出色散关系。
AI.conclusion: 所建立的导纳矩阵—重叠积分形式为孔径耦合腔的谐振特性提供了一般性解析框架，经简单系统验证有效，并可推广用于周期结构的色散关系数值求解。

title: Concurrent two-scale topology optimization of printable bone scaffolds via rectified-flow generation and exact latent-space refinement
summary: Bone scaffolds must reconcile a macroscale mechanical response with microscale geometric feasibility, yet conventional approaches to their design restrict attainable constitutive properties. This work presents a concurrent two-scale topology optimization framework; a conditional rectified flow generates periodic lattice microstructures, which are then refined in latent space by exact finite-element homogenization sensitivities. The resulting unit-cell geometries and their spatial assignments are jointly optimized under mechanical and feature-size constraints. In a distal rabbit femur benchmark, all eight flow-started refinements produce printable cells with maximum relative errors under 1\% across six prescribed engineering moduli. Constructing the implant from a single tiled cell reproduces intact whole-femur compliance within 0.1\% and regional strain energy within 0.35\% under four loading conditions. In human femoral reconstruction, multiscale concurrent optimization produces a cortical mid-shaft scaffold with porosity 63\% while satisfying the compliance constraint within 2\% under walking and stair-climbing loads. It achieves an 84\% porosity on a proximal cancellous scaffold with strain-energy deviations below 0.25\% under the same loads. Analysis of the learned representations reveals distinct architectural families in latent space. Further, the attention heads of the rectified-flow transformer specialize for spatial shifts -- learning the analogue of a finite-difference stencil -- and coordinate symmetries, with ablations showing their influence on generated topologies. These results establish a route to printable, mechanically constrained scaffold designs. The framework is general enough for extending to many other multiscale structural design applications including topology-microstructure co-design in metal additive manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 提出条件整流流生成周期性晶格微结构并结合精确有限元均质化灵敏度在潜空间精修的两尺度并发拓扑优化框架，实现可打印、受力学与特征尺寸约束的骨支架设计。
AI.motivation: 骨支架需同时协调宏观力学响应与微观几何可行性，而传统设计方法限制了可达的本构性能范围。
AI.method: 条件整流流（conditional rectified flow）生成周期性晶格单胞，再以精确有限元均质化灵敏度在潜空间精修；单胞几何与其空间分配在力学与特征尺寸约束下联合优化；并分析整流流Transformer注意力头对空间平移与坐标对称的学习行为，通过消融验证其影响。
AI.result: 兔股骨远端基准中，8组流初始化精修均生成可打印单胞，六种指定工程模量下最大相对误差低于1%；单胞平铺构建的植入体在四种载荷下复现完整股骨柔度误差0.1%内、区域应变能误差0.35%内。人股骨重建中，多尺度并发优化得到孔隙率63%的皮质中段支架（步行与爬楼载荷下柔度约束满足误差2%内），以及孔隙率84%的近端松质骨支架（应变能偏差低于0.25%）。潜空间呈现不同构型族。
AI.conclusion: 建立了通向可打印、力学约束支架设计的路径，框架可推广至金属增材制造中的拓扑-微结构协同设计等多尺度结构设计应用。

title: Experimental verification of the PRIORA Monte Carlo code for proton radiography
summary: PRIORA (Proton Radiography Ion-Optical Ray-tracing Analysis) is a fast Monte Carlo model for high-energy proton radiography. It combines fitted proton-matter interaction tables with energy-dependent transfer maps of arbitrary order and simulates approximately $10^6$ protons/s through a complete ion-optical system on an 8-core laptop. We verify it with GSI data obtained with the Ta_bench target: fifteen precision slits in a 2 mm Ta plate between symmetric PMMA staircases. A single experimental image provides the image scale, spatial resolution as a function of chromatic load, signed focus in both planes, effective angular acceptance and multiple-scattering contrast. With identical processing of experiment and simulation and no physics adjustment, PRIORA reproduces the data obtained with 2 and 4 GeV protons. At 2 GeV, PRIORA also recovers sub-percent quadrupole trims consistent with the control-system records and determines a target-plane spatial resolution of $115\pm6\,μ$m.

AI.tldr: PRIORA 是一种快速高能质子照相蒙特卡洛模型，将拟合的质子-物质相互作用表与任意阶能量相关传输映射相结合，在8核笔记本上以约10⁶质子/秒完成全离子光学系统模拟；用 Ta_bench 靶的 GSI 数据验证，无需物理调整即复现2与4 GeV数据，并在2 GeV下恢复亚百分比四极铁修正值及115±6 μm的空间分辨率。
AI.motivation: 高能质子照相实验的图像定量表征（尺度、分辨率、色散负载下的聚焦、角接受度、多次散射对比度）通常依赖实验本身，缺乏快速且可全系统建模的正向仿真工具；作者希望建立一个既能模拟完整离子光学系统、又能与实验图像在同一处理流程下直接对比的快速模型，从而实现无自由参数的数据验证与束流光学参数反演。
AI.method: 提出 PRIORA 模型：以拟合的质子-物质相互作用表描述能量损失与多次散射，并以任意阶、能量相关的传输映射描述离子光学系统，实现快速蒙特卡洛正演（8核笔记本约10⁶质子/秒）。验证采用 GSI 的 Ta_bench 靶——2 mm 厚 Ta 板上15条精密狭缝夹于对称 PMMA 阶梯之间——对实验与仿真图像施加完全相同的处理，不进行任何物理参数调整，分别与2 GeV和4 GeV质子数据比对，并同时提取图像尺度、分辨率随色散负载的变化、两平面带符号聚焦、有效角接受度与多次散射对比度。
AI.result: 在无物理调整条件下，PRIORA 复现了2 GeV与4 GeV的 GSI 实验数据；在2 GeV下恢复了与控制系统记录一致的亚百分比四极铁修正量（quadrupole trims），并确定靶平面空间分辨率为115±6 μm。
AI.conclusion: PRIORA 能够以高计算效率忠实复现高能质子照相实验图像，其精度足以支持从单幅实验图像中反演多重束流光学量（含亚百分比四极铁修正）与成像分辨率，表明将快速蒙特卡洛正演与统一的实验/仿真处理流程结合，可作为质子照相系统标定与光学诊断的有效工具。

title: Boosting fluorescence and polarization with nanophotonics for single-molecule chiral sensing
summary: Detecting chirality is essential in chemistry and biomedicine. Circular dichroism identifies chiral molecules through their differential absorption of circularly polarized light. However, its sensitivity is limited by vanishing absorption at low concentrations. Fluorescence-based methods have already enabled other optical techniques to reach the single-molecule limit and could, in principle, also extend chiral detection to reach this sensitivity regime. They are marred, however, by the combination of weak fluorescence signals and low polarization contrast. To overcome these limitations, we leverage high-index dielectric nanophotonics to simultaneously enhance both fluorescence and polarization for chiral sensing. We propose a reciprocity-based analytical framework for a chiral dipolar emitter coupled to a nanoantenna and reveal the different contributions and trade-offs governing the enhancement of circularly polarized fluorescence. Guided by this insight, we tailor achiral dielectric nanostructures to reach a 1000-fold enhancement of fluorescence intensity together with a 10-fold increase in polarization. Crucially, we show that accounting for extrinsic polarization effects in the angular emission patterns of nanophotonic structures is indispensable for reliable enantiomer discrimination. Our approach opens a realistic path for single-molecule chiral sensing.

AI.tldr: 提出基于互易原理的理论框架，利用高折射率介质纳米光子结构同时增强荧光强度与偏振，实现手性传感增强，为单分子手性检测提供路径。
AI.motivation: 圆二色性依赖吸收差、低浓度下吸收趋于消失导致灵敏度受限；荧光方法虽可达到单分子极限，但受弱荧光信号与低偏振对比度制约。
AI.method: 建立手性偶极发射体与纳米天线耦合的互易性解析框架，揭示圆偏振荧光增强的各贡献与权衡；据此设计非手性介质纳米结构。
AI.result: 实现荧光强度约1000倍增强与偏振约10倍提升；并表明角发射图案中外禀偏振效应对可靠对映体识别不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为单分子手性传感开辟了现实可行的技术路径。

title: Probing Flow-Induced Chain Scission in Shear-Banding Wormlike Micelles
summary: We investigate the microstructural dynamics of wormlike micellar (WLM) solutions based on CPyCl/NaSal/D\(_2\)O under shear flow using spatially resolved rheo-diffusion NMR, velocity-compensated diffusion measurements, and rheo-optical imaging in a Taylor--Couette geometry. Two viscoelastic systems were examined: a non-shear-banding WLM with a molar salt-surfactant concentration ratio of \(R=0.4\) and a shear-banding WLM with \(R=0.53\). Rheo-optical and velocity measurements confirm homogeneous flow for the non-shear-banding system and the coexistence of low- and high-shear bands within the stress-plateau regime for the shear-banding system. Despite the pronounced heterogeneity in velocity and shear rate associated with shear banding, the local surfactant self-diffusivity remains spatially uniform across the gap and throughout the stress-plateau regime. Furthermore, analysis of the mean-squared-displacement scaling reveals no measurable difference between the high- and low-shear bands. These results demonstrate that the micellar microstructure remains largely unchanged despite the formation of shear bands and provide direct experimental evidence that flow-induced micellar chain scission is not a dominant mechanism governing shear banding in this WLM system.

AI.tldr: 利用空间分辨流变-扩散NMR等方法，发现剪切带化WLM体系中局部表面活性剂自扩散系数在间隙内与应力平台区保持空间均匀，高/低剪切带间无MSD标度差异，说明剪切带形成不改变胶束微观结构，链断裂并非剪切带主导机制。
AI.motivation: 剪切带化（shear banding）通常伴随速度与剪切率的强空间非均匀性，其是否源于流动诱导的胶束微观结构改变（如链断裂）尚缺乏直接的实验证据，需在空间分辨层面探测微观动力学。
AI.method: 在Taylor–Couette几何中对CPyCl/NaSal/D₂O蠕虫状胶束体系开展实验，对比非剪切带化体系（R=0.4）与剪切带化体系（R=0.53）；采用空间分辨流变-扩散NMR、速度补偿扩散测量与流变-光学成像，测定局部自扩散系数及均方位移（MSD）标度。
AI.result: 流变-光学与速度测量确认R=0.4体系为均匀流动，R=0.53体系在应力平台区存在低/高剪切带共存；尽管速度与剪切率高度非均匀，局部表面活性剂自扩散系数在整个间隙及整个应力平台区内保持空间均匀，且高、低剪切带的MSD标度无可测差异。
AI.conclusion: 剪切带的形成基本不改变胶束微观结构；流动诱导的胶束链断裂并非该WLM体系剪切带化的主导机制。

title: Rydberg Atomic Receiver for Wireless Physical Layer: A Survey
summary: With the escalating development of the quantum information technologies, the Rydberg atomic receiver has been envisioned as a promising alternative to its classical electronic counterparts, attracting extensive attentions from both physics and electronic engineering disciplines. By exploiting the electrical acuteness of Alkali atoms with diverse Rydberg energy states for electromagnetic field measurement, Rydberg atomic receiver is capable of surmounting the inherent limitations on the operating bandwidth and detection sensitivity of the classical electronic counterparts. Against this background, this article provides an extensive overview of Rydberg atomic communication and sensing from fundamental theory, critical technologies to practical implementations. Firstly, the milestones of the Rydberg atomic receiver evolution was introduced. Then we provide a clear understanding of Rydberg atomic receiver mechanisms from the perspective of classical communication and sensing, and highlight the unprecedented advantages over traditional electronic receivers as well as the technical challenges. Afterwards, necessary fundamentals are presented including the Rydberg atoms, typical non-coherent/coherent structures, and explicit experimental configurations, followed by discussions on state-of-the-art development of the Rydberg atomic receiver. Specifically, advancements on electric-field detection methods for accurate measurement of amplitude, phase, frequency and polarization, are extensively investigated. Based on the established methodologies, recent innovations in Rydberg atomic communication and sensing are reviewed, ranging from waveform design and array-based signal processing to radar applications like localization, imaging and remote sensing, with practical experimental results presented. Finally, we summarize the promising research trends around Rydberg atomic receiver.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇关于里德堡原子接收机的综述，从基础理论、关键技术到实际实现，系统梳理了里德堡原子通信与感知的研究进展，涵盖电场探测方法（幅度、相位、频率、极化）、波形设计、阵列信号处理及雷达应用（定位、成像、遥感），并总结了未来研究趋势。
AI.motivation: 量子信息技术快速发展背景下，经典电子接收机在工作带宽与探测灵敏度上存在固有局限，而基于碱金属原子里德堡能态电磁场测量电学敏感性的里德堡原子接收机有望突破这些限制，成为经典电子接收机的有前景替代方案，因此亟需对该领域进行系统性综述。
AI.method: 采用综述性研究方法：先梳理里德堡原子接收机演进的里程碑；从经典通信与感知视角阐释其工作机制并对比传统电子接收机的优势与挑战；介绍里德堡原子、典型非相干/相干结构及实验配置等基础；进而详细考察幅度、相位、频率、极化等电场探测方法；并综述波形设计、阵列信号处理及雷达定位、成像、遥感等应用创新，附以实验验证结果。
AI.result: 综述表明，里德堡原子接收机在电场多维度（幅度、相位、频率、极化）精确测量方面已建立成熟方法体系，并在通信与感知领域形成从波形设计、阵列信号处理到雷达定位、成像与遥感的系列创新，部分已获实际实验验证成果。
AI.conclusion: 里德堡原子接收机作为量子信息技术赋能的接收方案，具备超越经典电子接收机的潜力；该综述系统整合了理论、技术与实践，并指出未来研究趋势，为后续研究提供参考框架。

title: Modeling and control of traveling wave structures with arbitrary beam loading
summary: Traveling wave (TW) structures are widely used in linear or circular accelerators for beam acceleration. Unlike the standing wave cavities, the overall accelerating voltage cannot be measured by the probes installed in the TW structures. This creates difficulties measuring and regulating the accelerating voltage and phase felt by the beam when it passes through the structure. In this paper, a model of TW structures is developed, allowing us to estimate the accelerating voltage and phase from the measurement of the RF drive power input to the TW structure. The beam loading effects, i.e., the beam-induced accelerating voltage and phase in the TW structure, are also included in the model. With the TW structure model, control methods are proposed to stabilize the accelerating voltage and phase felt by the beam based on feedback, feedforward, and optimization. The validity of the TW structure model is confirmed with the test results at the SwissFEL with improved beam stability under the same RF feedback controller. This work provides a firm basis for developing the multiple-bunch operation strategy for SwissFEL required by the future upgrade with more beamlines.

AI.tldr: 本文建立行波（TW）结构模型，由射频驱动功率反演束流实际感受的加速电压与相位（含束流负载效应），并提出反馈、前馈与优化相结合的控制方法以稳定之；在SwissFEL实测验证模型有效性并提升束流稳定性。
AI.motivation: 行波结构广泛用于直线或环形加速器的束流加速，但与驻波腔不同，其整体加速电压无法由腔内探针直接测量，导致束流实际感受的加速电压与相位难以测量和调节。
AI.method: 构建行波结构模型，从输入到TW结构的RF驱动功率测量值估计加速电压与相位，并将束流负载效应（束流感应的加速电压与相位）纳入模型；基于该模型提出反馈、前馈与优化三类控制方法以稳定束流感受的加速电压与相位。
AI.result: 在SwissFEL的测试结果验证了TW结构模型的有效性，在相同RF反馈控制器条件下束流稳定性得到改善。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为SwissFEL未来升级（更多束线）所需的多束团运行策略奠定了基础。

title: Decoherence of the pair entangled states at thermalization and interparticle interaction. Heisenberg--Wigner path integral Monte Carlo simulations
summary: For deeper understanding of quantum non-local correlations a new path integral real-time quantum dynamics approach has been developed and applied to the Monte Carlo simulation of the decoherence of pair entangled states in many-body systems in the framework of the ``replica trick''. Calculations have been carried out for the Heisenberg-Wigner path integral representation of the entangled state correlation function (ESCF) in the modified unified electron gas model as example. The Wiener-Khinchin transformation of ESCF has been applied to random paths in path integral allowing for the Monte Carlo simulation of ESCF. Presented results include the spin-resolved radial distribution functions, ESCFs and estimations of the decoherence time of the entangled electron pairs due to thermalization and interparticle interaction.

AI.tldr: 该文发展了实时路径积分量子动力学新方法，结合"复本技巧"与蒙特卡罗模拟，研究了多体系统中对纠缠态的退相干，并在改进的统一电子气模型上以Heisenberg-Wigner路径积分表示计算纠缠态关联函数及其退相干时间。
AI.motivation: 为更深入理解量子非局域关联，需要在多体体系框架下对纠缠对的退相干进行实时量子动力学描述与数值模拟。
AI.method: 提出实时路径积分量子动力学方法，在"复本技巧"框架下做蒙特卡罗模拟；以改进统一电子气模型为例，采用纠缠态关联函数(ESCF)的Heisenberg-Wigner路径积分表示；对随机路径应用Wiener-Khinchin变换，使ESCF可被蒙特卡罗模拟。
AI.result: 给出了自旋分辨的径向分布函数、ESCF，以及由热化与粒子间相互作用导致的纠缠电子对退相干时间的估计。
AI.conclusion: 该实时路径积分+复本技巧+蒙特卡罗的组合方案可作为研究多体系统中纠缠态退相干的有效途径。

title: Reinforcement Learning Controllers for Fusion Scenario Development
summary: Scenario development, the design of the waveforms that take a tokamak discharge from breakdown to flat-top, is still an iterative, labour-intensive process. Every candidate scenario has to be simulated with a controller in the loop, and the classical shape and current controllers need low-level actuator references. So the process is iterative and includes a number of trial-and-error steps. We propose to replace the per-scenario controller tuning by a single goal-conditioned reinforcement-learning controller trained once, in advance, against a free-boundary equilibrium and transport simulator. A scenario is then specified only by the target waveforms of the physical quantities of interest (plasma current, line-averaged electron density, LCFS shape, x-point positions), and the controller produces the coil-current and fueling commands that realize them. We demonstrate the approach on an EAST plasma-current ramp-up: the controller takes over a small limited plasma, ramps the current and the density, grows the cross-section, forms two x-points and holds a double-null diverted configuration against sampled shape targets for the rest of a 1.2 s episode. The neural network controller is trained using TQC algorithm. On 1024 test scenarios sampled from a low-discrepancy scrambled Sobol sequence in 11-dimensional target space, the controller forms the divertor in 86% of the cases, holds it for more than 0.5 s in 67% and reaches the end of the episode in a diverted state in 58%, with flat-top tracking errors of a few kA in plasma current, $\sim 0.15\times10^{19}$ m$^{-3}$ in density, $\sim 2$ cm in position and $\sim 8$ cm in x-point location; the failures concentrate at the high-current density ($J$) region which is believed to be physically or from engineering perspective not feasible within ohmic mode.

AI.tldr: 提出用单个目标条件强化学习控制器替代逐场景控制器调参，一次性训练后即可由目标波形驱动生成托卡马克从击穿到平顶的完整场景，在EAST电流爬升算例上验证了可行性。
AI.motivation: 传统scenario development需要每个候选场景在闭环下仿真并手工整定形状/电流控制器，且需给定执行器低层参考，过程迭代、试错多、人力密集。作者希望将“逐场景调参”替换为“一次训练、多目标复用”的策略。
AI.method: 训练一个goal-conditioned强化学习控制器（TQC算法），在自由边界平衡与输运仿真器中预先离线训练。场景仅由物理量目标波形（等离子体电流、线平均电子密度、LCFS形状、x点位置）指定，控制器输出线圈电流与加料指令。在EAST电流爬升任务上验证：从小限制器位形接管，爬升电流与密度、扩大截面、形成两个x点并维持双零偏滤器位形。
AI.result: 在11维目标空间中用低差异scrambled Sobol序列采样的1024个测试场景上：86%形成偏滤器，67%维持超过0.5 s，58%以偏滤器位形到达episode终点（1.2 s）。平顶跟踪误差：等离子体电流数kA、密度约0.15×10^19 m^-3、位置约2 cm、x点位置约8 cm。失败集中在高电流密度区域，作者认为该区域在欧姆模式下物理或工程上不可行。
AI.conclusion: 单一goal-conditioned RL控制器可替代逐场景的经典控制器整定，直接从目标波形生成执行器指令；性能受限于目标本身的可达性（高J区域），而非控制器能力，说明该框架可作为快速场景可行性筛选与自动场景设计的工具。

title: Dynamic Hotspot Migration and Self-Induced Resonances in Ultrafast Laser-Irradiated Silicon Thin Films
summary: The spatial distribution of energy in silicon thin films under femtosecond laser irradiation is demonstrated to be influenced by the interaction between carrier-induced refractive index modulation and self-induced Fabry-Pérot resonances. We resolve three characteristic excitation regions such as interface-localized, binodal and multi-nodal regimes considering the analysis of silicon-on-insulator (SOI) configurations across thicknesses of 100, 230, and 350 nm. We report a nonlinear hotspot migration effect where the transient reduction of the refractive index stretches the internal standing wave, translating intensity antinodes toward the film volume during the pulse. Numerical results demonstrate that at higher fluences, plasma-induced extinction suppresses internal reflections, triggering a transition from resonance-mediated absorption to plasma shielding. These findings establish a physical basis for depth-resolved modification in laser nanomanufacturing, providing a dual-capacity for simultaneous surface patterning and depth-resolved subsurface modification with direct applications in laser-assisted interfacial separation and 3D integrated photonic fabrication.

AI.tldr: 飞秒激光照射硅薄膜时的能量空间分布由载流子诱导折射率调制与自诱导Fabry-Pérot共振的相互作用决定。
AI.motivation: 厘清硅薄膜内部能量空间分布及共振机制，为激光纳米制造中的深度分辨改性提供物理基础。
AI.method: 对100、230、350 nm三种厚度的SOI构型进行数值分析，区分界面局域、双节点与多节点三种激发区，并考察高能量密度下的等离子体消光效应。
AI.result: 发现非线性热点迁移效应：折射率瞬态降低使内部驻波拉伸、强度波腹向膜体内部移动；高能量密度下等离子体消光抑制内反射，吸收由共振介导转变为等离子体屏蔽。
AI.conclusion: 该机制支持表面图案化与亚表面深度分辨改性的双重能力，可应用于激光辅助界面分离与三维集成光子制造。

title: Fractal forcing of turbulence by settling particles
summary: The settling of particles in a fluid medium can trigger complex collective dynamics, dramatically affecting the distribution of energy across flow scales. In this work we present the first fully-resolved observations of the turbulence induced by large particle structures, also known as cluster-induced-turbulence (CIT), obtained through particle-resolved direct numerical simulations at high volume fractions and density ratios in large domains. We find that particles arrange in macroscopic fractal structures, exciting turbulent fluctuations at scales much larger than the individual constituents. By virtue of their fractal nature, these clusters force the continuous-phase in a multiscale, self-similar way. We further show that these cluster-driven, vertically decorrelated fluctuations at large scales coexist with, but are fundamentally distinct from, the established particle-driven high-wavenumber scaling. Beyond unveiling a different form of clustering in particle-settling, these results highlight a naturally arising, self-assembling path to fractal-generated turbulence.

AI.tldr: 首次通过高体积分数、高密度比、大计算域的颗粒解析直接数值模拟，完整观测到由大尺度颗粒团簇诱发的湍流（CIT），发现颗粒自组织成宏观分形结构并以多尺度自相似方式驱动连续相湍流。
AI.motivation: 颗粒在流体中沉降会引发复杂集体动力学并显著改变能量在各流动尺度上的分布，但此前缺乏对颗粒团簇诱导湍流的完全解析观测。
AI.method: 采用颗粒解析直接数值模拟（particle-resolved DNS），在高体积分数、高密度比、大计算域条件下对沉降颗粒群进行完全解析模拟。
AI.result: 颗粒排列成宏观分形结构，激发远大于单个颗粒尺度的湍流脉动；团簇因其分形特性以多尺度、自相似的方式对连续相施力；团簇驱动的、沿垂向去相关的大尺度脉动与已知的颗粒驱动高波数标度律共存但本质不同。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了颗粒沉降中一种新的团簇形式，并指出这是一种自然涌现、自组装的通向分形生成湍流的路径。

title: Effect of Physical Barriers on High-Harmonic Generation in Liquid-Phase
summary: High-harmonic generation (HHG) in liquid-phase systems presents fundamental differences from gas and solid phases, notably a reduction in the harmonic cutoff, its apparent independence from laser parameters, and the appearance of a second plateau. In this work, we introduce a one-dimensional quantum model that incorporates physical boundaries to simulate the effect of solvation shells in liquid water by means of a complex absorbing potential (CAP). By systematically varying the position, width, and strength of the CAP, we explore how these physical constraints influence the HHG spectrum. Our findings confirm that spatial confinement, specifically the physical truncation of electron trajectories, is the primary factor governing the cutoff in liquid-phase HHG. This confinement leads to a cutoff that is independent of laser intensity and wavelength, aligning with experimental observations and existing hypotheses proposed by Mondal et al. in 2023 and 2026. Furthermore, by implementing a semi-transparent CAP, we successfully reproduce the less intense second plateau observed in liquid-phase HHG. Time-frequency analysis confirms that this characteristic spectral feature is driven by partial wave-packet transmission through the solvation shells, which allows a surviving fraction of electrons to undergo longer continuum excursions. Our one-dimensional approach successfully isolates the fundamental role of physical boundaries in liquid-phase HHG, providing a clear and intuitive understanding of the underlying physics.

AI.tldr: 本文建立含物理边界（以复吸收势CAP模拟溶剂化壳层）的一维量子模型，系统研究液相高次谐波产生（HHG）中截止频率降低、对激光参数不敏感及第二平台等特征，证实空间局域截断是主导因素，并揭示第二平台源于波包部分透射。
AI.motivation: 液相体系中的HHG与气相、固相存在本质差异：谐波截止降低、截止对激光参数（强度、波长）表现出明显的不依赖性，并出现第二平台；其物理成因尚缺乏直观、清晰的机制解释，已有工作（Mondal等2023、2026）仅提出了假设。
AI.method: 构建一维量子模型，引入复吸收势（CAP）模拟液态水中溶剂化壳层所致的物理边界；通过系统改变CAP的位置、宽度与强度，计算并分析HHG谱；并采用半透明CAP与时间—频率分析考察电子波包的输运行为。
AI.result: 计算表明，空间局域（即电子轨迹在物理上的截断）是决定液相HHG截止的主导因素，所得截止与激光强度和波长无关，与实验观测及已有假设一致；采用半透明CAP可复现液相HHG中强度较弱的第二平台，时间—频率分析证实该特征源于波包通过溶剂化壳层的部分透射，使少部分电子得以进行更长的连续区运动。
AI.conclusion: 一维方法成功隔离并阐明了物理边界在液相HHG中的基础性作用，为截止降低与双平台结构提供了简洁直观的物理图像；该框架可作为理解凝聚相/液相强场动力学的可推广简化模型。

title: A mixed leading variable physics-informed neural network for nonsmooth dynamics simulation in contact systems
summary: High-accuracy computation of nonsmooth dynamics is a challenging problem in systems with multiple frictional contacts. This study proposes a general physics-informed neural network framework, termed the mixed leading variable physics-informed neural network (MLV-PINN). By using the governing equations and contact-friction laws as physical constraints, this framework provides common solution approaches for computing nonsmooth dynamics not only in discrete systems but also in continuum systems. Specifically, the network represents accelerations, normal contact forces and friction margins as independent outputs and determines them simultaneously, without first reducing the dynamics to discrete velocity-impulse complementary subproblems. A composite physics-informed loss is constructed from the equations of motion in their original form, contact-friction complementary conditions and a friction-margin consistency relation. To improve stick-slip state identification during PINN optimisation, a mixed leading variable combining relative tangential velocity and acceleration is introduced to reformulate the tangential complementary conditions. Four benchmark simulations cover one-dimensional (1-D) nonsmooth dynamics involving single-contact stick-slip, 1-D nonsmooth dynamics involving multi-contact stick-slip, two-dimensional (2-D) nonsmooth dynamics with coupled normal contact-separation and tangential stick-slip, and 2-D nonsmooth dynamics in a continuum system involving moving contact on an elastic beam. Benchmark comparisons show substantial reductions in displacement and velocity errors relative to the corresponding conventional methods at large time steps. These results, together with an ablation study and tests involving friction-velocity slopes, long-time integration and loss weights, illustrate the computational accuracy and support the broad applicability of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 提出混合主导变量物理信息神经网络(MLV-PINN)，将加速度、法向接触力与摩擦裕度作为独立输出同步求解，直接在原始方程与接触-摩擦互补条件上构建复合物理损失，实现离散与连续系统非光滑动力学的高精度计算。
AI.motivation: 多摩擦接触系统的非光滑动力学高精度计算困难；传统方法需先将动力学降维为离散速度-冲量互补子问题，在大时间步下位移与速度误差显著。
AI.method: 以运动方程、接触-摩擦互补条件及摩擦裕度一致性关系构造复合物理信息损失；网络同时输出加速度、法向接触力与摩擦裕度，无需先做互补子问题降维；引入相对切向速度与加速度组合的混合主导变量重构切向互补条件，改善粘-滑状态识别。
AI.result: 四个基准算例（一维单接触/多接触粘滑、二维法向接触-分离与切向粘滑耦合、弹性梁上移动接触的连续体系统）显示，大时间步下相对传统方法位移与速度误差大幅降低；消融实验及摩擦-速度斜率、长时间积分、损失权重测试验证了精度与适用性。
AI.conclusion: MLV-PINN为离散与连续系统的非光滑摩擦接触动力学提供统一、高精度的求解框架，具备较广的工程适用性。

title: Beyond Radiation Hydrodynamics: A Coupled Kinetic Plasma and Radiation Modeling of NIF Polar Direct Drive Capsule
summary: Predictive modeling of inertial-confinement-fusion (ICF) implosions increasingly requires resolving ion-kinetic effects beyond the reach of radiation-hydrodynamics, without sacrificing radiation transport. We present, to our knowledge, the first coupling of a kinetic-ion plasma model to thermal radiation transport. The iFP code - a conservative, spherically symmetric, 1D2V hybrid kinetic-ion/fluid-electron Vlasov-Fokker-Planck solver - is extended with a grey P1 radiation model, coupled through a high-order/low-order (HOLO) fixed-point solver and advanced on a shared adaptive moving mesh. Opacities are mixed on the fly from the LANL TOPS library, exploiting the per-species information intrinsic to a kinetic code. We verify the implementation against the optically thick Marshak-wave and Mach-45 radiative-shock benchmarks, and apply it to a NIF polar-direct-drive exploding-pusher capsule. Increasing physics fidelity systematically improves agreement with the measured neutron yield and burn width; the improvement is driven by kinetically enhanced fuel leakage and ballistic preheating, and radiation transport proves essential for quantitative agreement. This work establishes a proof-of-principle capability for higher-fidelity kinetic-plasma/radiation modeling of ICF.

AI.tldr: 首次将动理学离子等离子体模型与热辐射输运耦合：在iFP混合动理学-离子/流体-电子Vlasov-Fokker-Planck求解器中加入灰体P1辐射模型，用HOLO定点求解器耦合、共享自适应移动网格，并应用于NIF极向直接驱动爆推靶验证。
AI.motivation: ICF内爆的预测建模日益需要解析辐射流体力学无法覆盖的离子动理学效应，同时不能牺牲辐射输运，因此亟需将动理学离子模型与辐射输运耦合。
AI.method: 在保守、球对称的1D2V混合动理学离子/流体电子VFP代码iFP中扩展灰体P1辐射模型；通过高阶/低阶（HOLO）定点求解器耦合，二者在共享自适应移动网格上推进；不透明度由LANL TOPS库在线混合，利用动理学代码固有的分species信息。
AI.result: 在光学厚Marshak波与马赫45辐射激波基准上完成验证；应用于NIF极向直接驱动爆推靶，随物理保真度提高，中子产额与燃烧宽度与实验测量的一致性系统性改善，改进源于动理学增强的燃料泄漏与弹道预热，辐射输运对定量吻合至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了面向ICF更高保真动理学等离子体/辐射建模的原理性验证能力。

title: Superradiant temporal transition radiation of a relativistic electron beam
summary: A charge in uniform motion carries a bound field that does not radiate. Transition radiation releases part of it at a boundary in space. We propose and analyze the case of radiation emission due to a boundary in time: a relativistic electron bunch passes through an aperture in a semiconductor (silicon) wafer, and while its bound field occupies the wafer, a femtosecond laser switches the semiconductor into an electron-hole plasma. The field is a valid solution of the old medium and not of the new one, so it is handed to the plasma as an initial condition for radiation emission at the plasma frequency. Because in temporal transition radiation (t-TR) the wavevector is conserved, and the frequency is not, the emission can appear in a spectral band that the bunch's own field does not populate. Every electron contributes in phase to the initial condition at the switching moment, so the emitted energy scales as $N^2$. We derive the field energy conversion at the temporal boundary and the resultant measurable amplitude and frequency line-shape of the radiation taking into consideration plasma carriers collisional loss. The simplified analytical model of the process and its scaling laws are confirmed by use of FDTD numerical computations for a reference case based on the parameters of an existing 6.5 MeV photoinjector accelerator. For this case we predict wideband t-TR radiation emission at THz frequencies, where the emission center frequency, near the plasma frequency, is selectable across an octave, set by the laser fluence, and the intensity is governed by the beam charge. The predicted radiative energy is detectable in a single shot. The experimental considerations for observing it are given in a Supplement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析"时间边界辐射"(t-TR):相对论电子束团穿过半导体薄片孔径,飞秒激光在束团束缚场占据晶圆期间把硅切换为电子-空穴等离子体,旧介质中的有效场成为新介质中的初始条件,在等离子体频率处辐射。由于波矢守恒而频率不守恒,辐射可出现在束团自身场不占据的谱段;各电子同相贡献使能量按 N² 标度。
AI.motivation: 均匀运动的电荷只携带不辐射的束缚场,空间边界处的渡越辐射只能释放其中一部分。作者希望利用"时间边界"(介质参数随时间突变)释放束缚场,获得谱段可选、相干增强的辐射源,填补传统渡越辐射在频率选择性与强度上的局限。
AI.method: 推导时间边界处的场能转换关系,计入等离子体载流子碰撞损耗,给出可测振幅与频率线型的解析表达式及标度律;并以现有 6.5 MeV 光阴极注入器参数为参考工况,用 FDTD 数值计算验证简化解析模型。
AI.result: 解析模型与 FDTD 结果一致。针对参考工况预测:在 THz 频段产生宽带 t-TR 辐射,中心频率接近等离子体频率,可由激光注量在一个倍频程范围内选择,强度由束团电荷控制;预测辐射能量可在单发(single-shot)条件下被探测。
AI.conclusion: 时间边界可将运动电荷的束缚场相干转换为辐射,提供频率可调(约一个倍频程)、强度由电荷决定、单发可测的 THz 宽带源;能量按 N² 标度。文中补充材料给出了实验观测方案与考量。

title: How stagnation lines move, persist and break up in fluid flows
