summary: Stagnation curves of arbitrary shape (zeros of $\mathbf v(\mathbf x,t)$) are non-generic yet common; we derive their motion. Differentiating $\mathbf v=\mathbf0$ gives $\mathbf L\mathbf U=-\mathbf a$ ($\mathbf U$ curve velocity, $\mathbf a=\mathbf v_t$, $\mathbf L=\nabla\mathbf v$ kills tangent, acts on normal plane via $2\times2$ block $\mathbf K$); dynamics enters only via $\mathbf a$. Normal velocity: $-\mathbf K^{-1}$ times normal $\mathbf a$; tangential solvability: scalar condition $Σ=0$ per point ($Σ$: part of $\mathbf a$ outside range $\mathbf L$). Potential flow: $\mathbf K$ is strain rate, normal velocity pressure gradient over principal strain rate $ε$, persistence needs uniform pressure on it. Stokes flow: tangential vorticity enters $\mathbf K$ (centre lines), $Σ$ involves normal vorticity. Navier-Stokes: $Σ$ set by instantaneous flow via nonlocal pressure, viscosity. If $Σ\ne0$, line becomes, to first order in $t$, isolated points at zeros of $Σ$ (critical points of $\varphi_t$ if potential; maybe none in Stokes flow: loops vanish). Symmetry (line an orbit of rigid-motion group, no velocity along it) suffices for persistence, not necessary: flows steady in rigidly moving frame have $Σ\equiv0$. Incompressibility enters via $\mathrm{tr}\mathbf K=0$; for inviscid irrotational homentropic compressible flow, line dilatation is $\varphi_{tt}/c^2$, so lines can be nodes, persistence needs uniform enthalpy, singular $\mathbf K$ arises at ordinary points, acoustic standing waves give exact examples (node line breaking into alternating sinks, saddles); also degenerate $\mathbf K$ (pairs born at distance $O(\sqrt t)$), curvature, torsion evolution, closure for moving-singularity-driven flows, helical and elliptically conical stagnation-point flow, exact Navier-Stokes example: saddle, centre lines split into four points per period.

AI.tldr: 论文从速度场零点 v=0 出发，推导任意形状驻线（驻点曲线）的运动：其法向速度由 ∇v 的法平面 2×2 块 K 与 v_t 决定，切向存在需逐点满足标量条件 Σ=0；并据此分析势流、Stokes 流、Navier–Stokes 流、可压缩无旋流及多种精确或示例情形。
AI.motivation: 驻线虽是非泛型结构却常见，作者希望给出其一般运动方程与持续/破裂判据，澄清不同流动中控制其演化的局部量。
AI.method: 对 v(x,t)=0 关于时间求导得 L U=-a，其中 U 为曲线速度、a=v_t、L=∇v；L 消去切向、在法平面通过 2×2 块 K 作用，由此得到法向速度公式和切向可解性条件 Σ=0。随后按势流、Stokes 流、Navier–Stokes 流和可压缩无旋流分别解释 K 与 Σ，并用对称性、不可压条件、声驻波、螺旋与椭圆锥驻点流及精确 Navier–Stokes 解等情形说明。摘要未提供实验或数值验证细节。
AI.result: 法向速度为 -K^{-1} 乘 a 的法向分量；切向可解性要求每点 Σ=0，Σ 是 a 中超出 range L 的部分。若 Σ≠0，驻线在一阶时间精度下退化为 Σ 的零点所对应的孤立点；势流中为 φ_t 的临界点，Stokes 流中可能没有此类点，环路可消失。势流中 K 为应变率，法向速度由压力梯度除以主应变率 ε 给出，持续需该线上压力均匀；Stokes 流中切向涡量进入 K（中心线），Σ 涉及法向涡量；Navier–Stokes 流中 Σ 由瞬时流动经非局部压力与黏性决定。对称性足以保证持续但非必要；在刚性运动参考系中定常的流满足 Σ≡0。不可压性通过 tr K=0 进入；无黏无旋均熵可压缩流中驻线膨胀率为 φ_tt/c^2，持续需均匀焓，普通点可出现奇异 K，声驻波给出节点线分裂为交替汇与鞍的精确例子；还讨论退化 K（成对驻线以 O(√t) 距离产生）、曲率与挠率演化、运动奇点驱动流的闭合、螺旋与椭圆锥驻点流，以及精确 Navier–Stokes 例子：鞍点、中心线每周期分裂为四点。
AI.conclusion: 驻线运动可由局部速度梯度 K 与 v_t 的切向/法向分解统一描述，Σ=0 是其持续的关键逐点条件；Σ≠0 则导致驻线瞬时破裂为孤立驻点。该框架统一解释了势流、Stokes 流、Navier–Stokes 流、可压缩流及对称与退化等情形，并给出可验证的精确例子。

title: How Much Does Auger Spectroscopy Add to XAS? A Fisher-information Analysis of Core-Hole Dynamics in $Ar^+$
summary: X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) and resonant-Auger spectroscopy probe different stages of core-hole excitation and decay, but distinct spectra need not provide independent information about decay parameters. We quantify their complementarity for the $Ar^+$ $2p\to3d$ manifold using state-resolved atomic calculations and a two-parameter Fisher-information model. A common scale of primary autoionization rates $s_Γ$ and a selective spectator-$pp$ rescaling $η_{pp}$ both alter XAS linewidths. Their spectral responses are nearly collinear because the spectator-$pp$ fraction varies weakly among populated intermediate states. We compare XAS with an effective, scan-integrated, normalized Auger spectrum defined on a final-state-energy coordinate, with fixed excitation weights and final-state widths. Within this reduced observable, the common rate scale cancels from the normalized branching fractions, while $η_{pp}$ redistributes intensity among ionic final states. This cancellation is a property of the adopted model, not of photon-energy-resolved resonant-Auger spectroscopy generally. Under the reference count and resolution assumptions, XAS alone yields a Cramér-Rao lower bound (CRLB) corresponding to a 1.20% local fractional standard uncertainty in the excitation-weighted total natural width; adding Auger reduces this uncertainty by only 0.70%. In contrast, the uncertainty in the spectator-$pp$ branching fraction falls by 99.19%, with similarly large gains for partial-rate scales. A generalized Fisher comparison gives a 123.5-fold improvement on the standard-deviation scale along the most enhanced information mode. Thus, the principal benefit of the complementary Auger observable is to resolve a nearly degenerate decay-channel decomposition rather than substantially refine the total natural width.

AI.tldr: 该文用态分辨原子计算与双参数Fisher信息模型，量化XAS与Auger对Ar⁺ 2p→3d衰变参数的互补性：XAS主导总自然宽度，Auger主要解决近简并的衰变通道分解。
AI.motivation: XAS与共振Auger谱探测核孔激发与衰变的不同阶段，但不同谱并不必然提供独立的衰变参数信息；作者希望定量刻画两者在Ar⁺ 2p→3d流形上的互补程度，明确各自约束哪些参数。
AI.method: 态分辨原子计算＋两参数Fisher信息模型；参数为主自电离速率共同标度s_Γ与选择性spectator-pp重标度η_pp；比较XAS与在末态能量坐标上定义、固定激发权重与末态宽度的扫描积分归一化有效Auger谱，比较CRLB与广义Fisher信息。
AI.result: XAS单独给出激发加权总自然宽度1.20%的局部相对标准不确定度（CRLB），加入Auger仅降至0.70%；而spectator-pp分支比不确定度下降99.19%，分速率标度亦有类似大增益；广义Fisher比较沿最强信息模的标准差尺度改善123.5倍。归一化分支比中s_Γ抵消、η_pp重新分配末态强度，谱响应近乎共线，因spectator-pp比例在中间态间变化微弱。
AI.conclusion: 互补Auger可观测量的主要价值在于分辨近简并的衰变通道分解，而非显著精化总自然宽度；s_Γ的抵消是所采用模型的性质，并不适用于一般的光子能量分辨共振Auger谱。

title: CuAD: Source-to-Source Automatic Differentiation of CUDA Kernels for Discrete Adjoints in Computational Fluid Dynamics
comment: 20 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Code available at https://github.com/SEUNGHYUN-JOO/CuAD
summary: Discrete adjoint methods give the sensitivities that aerodynamic design and data assimilation require, but they remain hard to obtain for flow solvers that run on graphics processors. This paper presents CuAD, a source-to-source automatic differentiation tool that reads CUDA kernels and writes their tangent and adjoint versions as ordinary CUDA source. Its reverse mode is organised around the GPU thread and exploits the structure of flow-solver kernels: pure accumulations need no tape, the remaining intermediate values are recomputed rather than stored, and adjoint updates are atomic only where several threads reach the same memory. We evaluate CuAD on four kernels from simple flow models: a viscous Burgers residual, a two-dimensional advection-diffusion residual, a quasi-one-dimensional Euler residual and a Biot-Savart summation over point vortices. All generated derivatives agree with finite differences and pass adjoint dot-product tests to round-off, while the adjoint kernels cost two to six times the primal kernels. Compared with the compiler-based tool Clad under the same compiler, CuAD gives identical results at identical cost on the stencil kernels and is 16 to 470 times faster on the summation kernel because it stores no tape. A steady Burgers study shows that in single precision the adjoint gradient of a finite-difference Jacobian reaches errors of 45 to 75 per cent once the condition number grows to $2.5\times10^{5}$, whereas the CuAD Jacobian keeps the error below $5\times10^{-5}$. Four applications complete the evaluation: adjoint fields of the Burgers shock, the sensitivity of a scalar sensor in a cellular vortex, the inverse design of a transonic nozzle whose area is recovered to $2\times10^{-8}$, and an unsteady adjoint of the roll-up of a vortex sheet over 400 time steps.

AI.tldr: CuAD 是一个源到源的自动微分工具，将 CUDA 核函数自动转换为切线/伴随版本，以 GPU 线程为组织单位并结合流求解器核结构（纯累加免记录、中间值重算、必要时原子更新），在四个流动模型核上导数与有限差分及伴随点积测试一致，伴随核耗时为主核 2–6 倍，求和核比 Clad 快 16–470 倍。
AI.motivation: 气动设计与数据同化需要离散伴随灵敏度，但面向 GPU 运行的流求解器难以获得伴随。现有编译器方案（如 Clad）在求和型核上因需存储磁带（tape）而效率低。
AI.method: 提出源到源自动微分工具 CuAD：读取 CUDA 核并输出普通 CUDA 源形式的切线与伴随代码；反向模式以 GPU 线程为组织核心，利用流求解器核的结构——纯累加无需磁带、其余中间值采用重算而非存储、仅当多线程访问同一内存时才使用原子伴随更新。
AI.result: 在黏性 Burgers 残差、二维对流扩散残差、准一维 Euler 残差与点涡 Biot–Savart 求和四个核上，生成导数与有限差分一致、通过伴随点积测试至舍入误差，伴随核耗时为主核 2–6 倍；同编译器下与 Clad 在模板核上结果与成本完全相同，求和核因不存磁带快 16–470 倍。单精度稳态 Burgers 研究中，条件数增至 2.5×10⁵ 时有限差分 Jacobian 伴随梯度误差达 45–75%，而 CuAD Jacobian 误差低于 5×10⁻⁵。四项应用：Burgers 激波伴随场、胞状涡中标量传感器灵敏度、跨声速喷管逆设计（面积恢复到 2×10⁻⁸）、400 时间步涡面卷起的非定常伴随。
AI.conclusion: CuAD 以线程级反向模式和重算策略，在 GPU 上高效、准确地产生流求解器伴随，兼顾模板核与求和型核性能，并在病态问题与多项工程应用中验证了鲁棒性。

title: Ion Heating in Pair-loaded Relativistic Turbulence
summary: Pair-loaded relativistic turbulence is expected in compact high-energy astrophysical environments and may sustain plasma heating. Using self-consistent three-dimensional radiative particle-in-cell simulations, we identify the mechanism of ion heating mediated by pair-enhanced radiative feedback in relativistic turbulence. We derive the theoretical criterion for the transition to a regime dominated by radiative feedback and show that pair loading promotes the growth and persistence of large, connected optically thick structures. These long-lived structures sustain intense localized ion heating, repeatedly generating prominent hot-ion clumps and substantially enhancing the mean ion temperature. Our results establish a physical link between pair creation and sustained ion heating, providing a theoretical basis for investigating intermittent hot-ion production in black-hole coronae and gamma-ray burst outflows.

AI.tldr: 通过自洽三维辐射粒子网格模拟，揭示了在相对论湍流中由对产生增强的辐射反馈介导的离子加热机制，并给出辐射反馈主导区间的理论判据。
AI.motivation: 致密高能天体环境中的对加载相对论湍流可能维持等离子体加热，但其中离子加热的物理机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用自洽三维辐射粒子网格（radiative PIC）模拟，结合理论分析推导辐射反馈区间的转变判据。
AI.result: 对加载促进大尺度、连通的光学厚结构的生长与维持；这些长寿命结构持续产生局域强离子加热，反复生成显著的“热离子团”，并显著提升平均离子温度。
AI.conclusion: 建立了对产生与持续离子加热之间的物理联系，为研究黑洞冕与伽马射线暴外流中的间歇性热离子产生提供理论基础。

title: Design and synthesis of laser inscribed flexible Bragg gratings containing silicon oxynitride-doped silicon thin film for authentication applications with the insights from X-Ray Absorption Spectroscopy and Quantum Mechanical Calculations
summary: Silicon-on-insulator is mostly the main driving material system for the field of silicon photonics, including PICs, due to high index contrast and compatibility with current semiconductor manufacturing processes [1]. A recent example is silicon oxynitride-doped silicon [2] discovered recently by our group, offering to set a new position for the fields of silicon photonics with a precise control of refractive index from 2.1 to 2.5 together with the photosensitivity property at different wavelengths. In this study, we demonstrate that the synthesis of silicon oxynitride-doped silicon can be performed on a flexible substrate for the fabrication of Bragg gratings (BG) at low temperatures below 100 degrees Celsius that are emerging for advanced applications. Their use in preserving ultra-fast lasers inscribed micro-information has been demonstrated numerically and experimentally due to its multispectral reflection behaviour from the ultraviolet (UV) to the near-infrared (NIR) regions. The unique structural characteristics of silicon oxynitride-doped silicon were studied at the Si L, O K and N K edges using soft X-ray absorption studies. The quantum mechanical calculations provide the potential formation mechanism of SiON-doped Si, whereas the crystal structure prediction for bulk Si3N4-xOx was conducted using the particle swarm optimization method in combination with density functional theory (DFT).

AI.tldr: 该研究将掺氧氮化硅硅(SiON-doped Si)材料合成拓展至柔性衬底，在低于100°C条件下制备布拉格光栅，实现紫外至近红外多光谱反射，并用软X射线吸收谱与DFT/粒子群优化揭示其结构与形成机制。
AI.motivation: 绝缘体上硅(SOI)因高折射率对比度和与半导体工艺兼容而主导硅光子学，但需要一种折射率可精确调控(2.1–2.5)且具光敏特性的新材料，并能在柔性衬底、低温工艺下集成，以拓展硅光子学应用(如保护超快激光刻写的微信息)。
AI.method: 在低于100°C温度下于柔性衬底上合成掺氧氮化硅硅并制备布拉格光栅(BG)；利用软X射线吸收谱在Si L边、O K边和N K边表征其独特结构特征；通过量子力学计算探讨SiON掺杂Si的潜在形成机制；采用粒子群优化结合密度泛函理论(DFT)对块体Si3N4-xOx进行晶体结构预测。
AI.result: 成功在柔性衬底低温(<100°C)制备BG，其多光谱反射行为覆盖紫外(UV)至近红外(NIR)区域；数值与实验均验证了其用于保护超快激光刻写微信息的能力；软X射线吸收研究揭示了材料结构特征，计算给出了形成机制与晶体结构预测结果。
AI.conclusion: 掺氧氮化硅硅可在柔性衬底上低温集成并制备布拉格光栅，兼具折射率精确调控与光敏特性，具备UV–NIR多光谱反射功能，为硅光子学及柔性光子器件提供新平台。

title: Assisted Turbulence Modeling via Data Assimilation and Machine Learning for Turbomachinery Flows
summary: This work presents the development and assessment of a hybrid framework coupling numerical simulation, experimental samples, data assimilation (DA) and machine learning (ML) to investigate the flow within an axial compressor stage. The methodology first implements a Multi-Fidelity Ensemble Kalman Filter (MFEnKF) which integrates experimental PIV data with a two-fidelity numerical simulation setup, combining steady-state RANS on a fixed grid with unsteady hybrid RANS/LES simulations on a moving grid. This data assimilation step successfully reduces discrepancies between experiments and CFD realizations. Besides, it provides additional high fidelity samples when compared with the available PIV data. This enriched database is used to train machine learning (ML) tools, with the objective to obtain black-box forcing terms to be included in the discretized form of the Navier-Stokes equations. These models are expected to preserve the accuracy of the DA results while not longer requiring the input of experimental data. The neural network architecture used here maps local physical features such as the velocity, the velocity gradients and the turbulent viscosity, to obtain the volume forcing terms. The analysis of the performance of such ML models shows that global accuracy is preserved but localized increased errors in specific regions of the compressor, such as close to the blade tips, can exceed those observed from the baseline RANS simulations. To resolve this issue, a Mixture of Experts (MoE) method is employed, which classifies and combines the trained ML tools for different flow regions. The discrepancy with experimental data of this method is systematically lower than the one observed for the baseline RANS solution and very similar to the one obtained with the MFEnKF.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一个耦合数值模拟、实验测量、数据同化与机器学习的混合框架，用多保真集成卡尔曼滤波融合PIV数据构建增广数据库，再训练神经网络以获得嵌入N-S方程离散形式的体积力源项，并用专家混合方法分区组合模型以抑制叶尖附近局部误差。
AI.motivation: 纯CFD（RANS）与实验PIV之间存在偏差，而数据同化虽能校正但依赖实验数据输入、成本高；希望获得不依赖实验数据、同时保持数据同化精度的替代模型。
AI.method: 轴流压气机级内流研究：先构建多保真集合卡尔曼滤波（MFEnKF），将PIV数据与双保真数值模拟（固定网格稳态RANS + 移动网格非定常混合RANS/LES）融合；以增广的高保真样本训练ML模型，输入速度、速度梯度、湍流黏度等局部特征，输出体积力源项并嵌入离散N-S方程；针对局部误差采用专家混合（MoE）按流区分类并组合多个ML模型。
AI.result: MFEnKF有效减小实验与CFD之间的偏差并补充高保真样本；单一ML模型整体精度得以保持，但在叶尖等特定区域局部误差可超过基线RANS；引入MoE后，与实验数据的偏差系统性低于基线RANS，且与MFEnKF结果非常接近。
AI.conclusion: MFEnKF+ML+MoE的混合框架可在无需实验数据输入的推理阶段重现数据同化级别的精度，MoE分区组合是抑制局部误差、优于基线RANS的关键。

title: Observation and control of polariton noise in a thermal Rydberg atom electrometer
summary: The establishment of metrics and control of fundamental noise sources in quantum sensing is a long-standing goal in quantum science and technology. We report on the observation of polariton-mediated optical noise in a thermal Rydberg atom vapor and demonstrate its active control and suppression using a radio-frequency field in Rydberg electrometry. The noise exhibits structured amplification and reduction across the Rydberg electromagnetically induced transparency resonance. This reveals a nonlinear slow-light feedback mechanism in which the polariton medium stores and releases probe-field energy. We show that the reference radio-frequency field used in Rydberg heterodyne receivers can also tune the medium into an operating regime where high electromagnetic-field responsivity coincides with reduced optical noise. This operating-point control enables optimization of the electric-field sensitivity within the constraints imposed by Rydberg-polariton physics. These results establish polariton noise as a previously unrecognized intrinsic noise source in thermal Rydberg vapors and the corresponding control method as a crucial aspect of continued efforts to achieve fundamental sensitivity limits in Rydberg electrometry.

AI.tldr: 该文在热Rydberg原子蒸气中观测到polariton介导的光学噪声，揭示其源自非线性慢光反馈机制，并利用参考射频场主动调控工作点，实现高电场响应度与低光学噪声的兼顾，从而优化Rydberg电场测量灵敏度。
AI.motivation: 量子传感中基本噪声源的度量与控制是长期目标；热Rydberg蒸气中是否存在未被识别的本征噪声源及其对电场测量灵敏度极限的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 在Rydberg电磁诱导透明（EIT）共振上测量polariton介导的光学噪声谱结构，分析其放大与抑制行为以识别慢光反馈机制；并利用Rydberg外差接收中的参考射频场调节介质工作点，评估电场响应度与光学噪声的联合优化。
AI.result: 噪声在Rydberg EIT共振范围内呈现结构化的放大与抑制，归因于polariton介质存储与释放探测场能量的非线性慢光反馈；参考射频场可将介质调至电场响应度高且光学噪声降低的工作区，实现受Rydberg-polariton物理约束下的电场灵敏度优化。
AI.conclusion: Polariton噪声被确立为热Rydberg蒸气中此前未被认识的本征噪声源，相应的工作点控制方法是迈向Rydberg电场测量基本灵敏度极限的关键环节。

title: All-Dielectric Tight-Binding Photonics via a Band-Gap Vacuum
summary: Tight-binding photonics bridges condensed-matter physics and optics, providing a powerful framework for engineering band structures and topological phases with light. For photons, however, the vacuum is gapless, so resonators in air carry radiative tails that produce spurious long-range couplings. Here we embed resonators in a photonic band-gap vacuum (BgV), a photonic crystal whose band gap plays for photons the role vacuum plays for bound electrons. The BgV localizes each resonance exponentially, so designed short-range couplings define the lattice Hamiltonian. We thereby experimentally realize a faithful Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes Hamiltonian in an all-dielectric photonic crystal, resolving corner resonances and their orbitals in microwave measurements. Unlike the vacuum surrounding electrons, the BgV is itself designable, controlling relative couplings and closed-loop interference through its band dispersion and Bloch modes. Full-wave calculations and extracted models show that uniformly modifying the BgV, with all resonators fixed, switches the quantized polarization of a two-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattice and converts a zero-flux lattice into a $π$-flux one. We also numerically realize three-dimensional pyrochlore and hyperhoneycomb lattices with space groups $R\bar{3}m$ and $C2/c$, the latter a nodal-loop semimetal with topological drumhead surface states. These results establish the BgV as a designable vacuum for all-dielectric tight-binding photonics in two and three dimensions.

AI.tldr: 将谐振器嵌入光子带隙真空（BgV）中，消除空气中辐射尾巴导致的寄生长程耦合，从而在介质光子晶体中实验实现忠实的紧束缚哈密顿量，并证明BgV本身可设计以调控耦合与阻挫。
AI.motivation: 光子真空是无能隙的，空气中谐振器具有辐射尾巴，产生非设计的长程耦合，使紧束缚光子晶格哈密顿量不忠实。电子在固体中受能隙真空束缚而可局域，光子缺少对应的"有能隙真空"。
AI.method: 以光子晶体带隙作为"光子真空"（BgV），使每个谐振模式指数局域，短程耦合由设计决定；在全介质光子晶体中实验实现Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes（BBH）模型，用微波测量分辨角态及其轨道；通过改变BgV的带色散与Bloch模式调控相对耦合与环路干涉；辅以全波计算与提取模型。
AI.result: 实验观测到BBH角共振及其轨道；固定全部谐振器、仅均匀改变BgV即可切换二维SSH晶格的量子化极化，并把零通量晶格转变为π通量晶格；数值实现空间群R-3m的三维烧绿石与C2/c的超蜂窝晶格，后者为具有拓扑鼓面表面态的节点线半金属。
AI.conclusion: BgV可作为二维与三维全介质紧束缚光子学的可设计真空，为能带工程与拓扑光子学提供新范式。

title: Bridging the Lattice Boltzmann Method and Moment Methods
summary: We derive discrete moment equations exactly equivalent to the lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) and identify the general moment closure shared by kinetic methods based on the discrete-velocity Boltzmann equation. This closure provides a route to correct lower-order dynamics without requiring accurate reconstruction of the higher-order moments, thereby substantially broadening the scope of existing closure strategies that seek increasingly accurate representations of these moments. These advances establish a unified moment framework bridging LBM and moment methods. The framework enables efficient simulations across all Knudsen regimes, overcoming the prohibitive complexity of existing moment methods at high Knudsen numbers. It further provides a common basis for integrating and extending key features of diverse kinetic methods.

AI.tldr: 本文推导出与格子Boltzmann方法(LBM)严格等价的离散矩方程，并识别出基于离散速度Boltzmann方程的动理学方法所共享的一般矩封闭，从而建立统一LBM与矩方法的框架，实现全Knudsen数区间的高效模拟。
AI.motivation: 现有矩方法在高Knudsen数下复杂度极高，且依赖对高阶矩越来越精确的重构；同时LBM与矩方法缺乏统一理论基础。
AI.method: 严格推导与LBM精确等价的离散矩方程；识别离散速度Boltzmann方程类动理学方法共有的矩封闭关系；利用该封闭无需精确重构高阶矩即可修正低阶动力学。
AI.result: 提出的一般矩封闭提供了修正低阶动力学的途径，无需高阶矩的精确重构，显著拓展了既有封闭策略的适用范围；框架可在全Knudsen数区间高效模拟，克服高Knudsen数下现有矩方法的复杂性障碍。
AI.conclusion: 建立了桥接LBM与矩方法的统一矩框架，为整合并拓展多种动理学方法的关键特性提供共同基础。

title: High-Efficiency Silicon-Lithium Niobate Grating Coupler enabled by Fully-Etched Subwavelength Structures
summary: A new approach of silicon-lithium niobate (Si-LN) grating couplers (GCs) with a fully-etched structure is proposed. The coupling strength is engineered through subwavelength structures, allowing improved directionality. The adjoint-based inverse design method is simultaneously adopted to achieve efficient coupling between photonic circuits and fibers. Considering the birefringence of LN, the proposed Si-LN GCs are optimized and fabricated for TE mode along the crystallographic Z and Y directions. The experimentally measured coupling efficiencies are -3.3 dB and -3.9 dB along the crystallographic Z and Y directions, respectively. The measured 3-dB bandwidths are broader than 54 nm and the back reflections can be suppressed down to -15 dB over 50 nm for both directions. The proposed Si-LN GCs are realized by only single-step Si etching, offering a practical solution for fast device prototyping in Si-LN photonic integrated circuits.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全刻蚀结构的硅-铌酸锂(Si-LN)光栅耦合器，利用亚波长结构调控耦合强度并结合伴随算法逆向设计，实现TE模在LN晶体Z、Y方向的高效耦合，实测耦合效率-3.3 dB与-3.9 dB，3-dB带宽>54 nm，回波反射抑制至-15 dB，且仅需单步硅刻蚀即可制备。
AI.motivation: 硅-铌酸锂光子集成电路需要高效、易制备的电路-光纤耦合方案；LN存在双折射，传统光栅耦合器方向性受限，且多步刻蚀工艺不利于快速原型验证。
AI.method: 设计全刻蚀Si-LN光栅耦合器，通过亚波长结构工程化耦合强度以提升方向性；同时采用基于伴随(adjoint)的逆向设计方法优化电路与光纤间的耦合；针对LN双折射，分别沿晶体Z方向和Y方向对TE模进行优化与制备，工艺仅需单步硅刻蚀。
AI.result: 实测耦合效率：Z方向-3.3 dB，Y方向-3.9 dB；两方向3-dB带宽均大于54 nm；50 nm范围内回波反射抑制至-15 dB以下。
AI.conclusion: 该Si-LN光栅耦合器通过亚波长结构+伴随逆向设计实现高方向性与高效率耦合，且仅需单步硅刻蚀，为Si-LN光子集成电路的快速器件原型验证提供了实用方案。

title: LIDAR with Optically Amplified Thermal Light
summary: Thermal light exhibits intensity fluctuations or photon bunching that has been used as a source of entropy or temporally correlated light. However, its low spectral density limits its use in practical applications like LIDAR. One method of remedying this is optical amplification to boost its brightness. In this paper, we show that the normalized second order coherence function $g^{(2)}(τ)$ of a thermal light source is preserved after amplification. We then use amplified thermal light to demonstrate a LIDAR raster scan of a building at 1.3 km with a depth resolution of 2 cm.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明热光在放大后归一化二阶相干函数 $g^{(2)}(\tau)$ 保持不变，并利用放大热光实现对 1.3 km 外建筑的 LIDAR 光栅扫描，深度分辨率达 2 cm。
AI.motivation: 热光的强度涨落（光子聚束）可作为熵源或时域相关光源，但其低谱密度限制了在 LIDAR 等实际场景中的应用；光放大虽能提升亮度，但放大是否破坏热光的相干特性需要验证。
AI.method: 对热光源进行光学放大，测量并比较放大前后归一化二阶相干函数 $g^{(2)}(\tau)$；随后以放大热光为光源，搭建 LIDAR 系统对 1.3 km 处建筑执行光栅扫描测距。
AI.result: 放大后热光的 $g^{(2)}(\tau)$ 得以保持；基于放大热光的 LIDAR 在 1.3 km 距离上实现建筑光栅扫描成像，深度分辨率达到 2 cm。
AI.conclusion: 光学放大可在提升热光亮度与谱密度的同时保留其二阶相干特性，从而有效扩展热光在远程高精度 LIDAR 等应用中的实用性。

title: Magneto-Rayleigh-Taylor instability driven by a rotating magnetic field: Cylindrical liner configuration
summary: We propose using a directional time-varying (rotating) driving magnetic field to suppress magneto-Rayleigh-Taylor (MRT) instability in dynamic Z-pinches. A rotational drive magnetic field is equivalent to two magnetic-field components, Θ and Z, that alternate in time, referred to as an alternate Theta-Z-pinch configuration. We consider the finitely thick cylindrical liner configuration in this paper. We numerically integrate the perturbation equation to stagnation time based on the optimal background unperturbed trajectories. We assess the cumulative growth of the dominant mode selected by some mechanism at the beginning of an implosion. The maximum e-folding number at stagnation of the dominant mode of an optimized alternate Theta-Z-pinch is significantly lower than that of the standard Theta- or Z-pinch. The directional rotation of the magnetic field contributes to suppress the instabilities, independent of the finite thickness. The finite thickness effect plays a role only when the orientation of the magnetic field varies in time whereas it does not appear in the standard Theta- or Z-pinch. The rotating frequency of the magnetic field and the thickness of liner are both having a monotonic effect on suppression. Their synergistic effect can enhance the suppression on MRT instability. Because the MRT instability can be well suppressed in this way, the alternate Theta-Z-pinch configuration has potential applications in liner inertial fusion. This work is supported by the NSFC (Grant Nos. 11405167, 51407171, 11571293, 11605188, and 11605189) and the Foundation of the China Academy of Engineering Physics (No. 2015B0201023).

AI.tldr: 提出用方向随时间旋转的驱动磁场抑制动态Z箍缩中的MRT不稳定性，等价于Θ-Z交替箍缩构型；数值积分扰动方程表明其最优构型在滞止时的最大e倍增数显著低于标准Θ或Z箍缩，且转动频率与套筒厚度对抑制呈单调增强并具协同效应。
AI.motivation: 动态Z箍缩中磁瑞利-泰勒（MRT）不稳定性会破坏套筒内爆的对称性与滞止性能，需寻找有效抑制手段。
AI.method: 采用方向随时间旋转（旋转）的驱动磁场，等价为Θ与Z两个磁场分量随时间交替的"交替Θ-Z箍缩"构型；针对有限厚度圆柱套筒，基于最优背景未扰动轨迹将扰动方程数值积分至滞止时刻，评估内爆初期由某机制选出的主导模态的累积增长（e倍增数），并与标准Θ箍缩、Z箍缩对比；进一步考察磁场转动频率与套筒厚度的作用。
AI.result: 优化后的交替Θ-Z箍缩主导模态在滞止时的最大e倍增数显著低于标准Θ箍缩或Z箍缩；磁场的定向旋转对不稳定性的抑制与套筒有限厚度无关，有限厚度效应仅在磁场方向随时间变化时起作用；磁场转动频率与套筒厚度对抑制均呈单调影响，二者协同可增强对MRT不稳定性的抑制。
AI.conclusion: 旋转驱动磁场（交替Θ-Z箍缩）可有效抑制MRT不稳定性，在套筒惯性聚变（liner inertial fusion）中具有潜在应用价值。

title: Study of non-uniformity-induced structured spectrum in a tapered optical fiber through stimulated four-wave mixing
summary: Tapered optical fibers offer tunable dispersion and a small mode area, yielding high nonlinearity, which makes them ideal for nonlinear and quantum optics. Because phase-matched four-wave mixing strongly depends on dispersion, the taper diameter becomes a key parameter. For sub-micrometer tapers, identifying the exact diameter is challenging. Here, we show that when seeding with a broad spectrum, stimulated four-wave mixing yields a comb-like spectrum that is directly linked to the overall taper profile opening possibility for non-destructive evaluation of sub-micron taper. Our model based on joint-spectral amplitude includes the phase accumulated over the fiber length.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于宽谱种子受激四波混频的梳状光谱方法，可无损评估亚微米锥形光纤的整体直径分布。
AI.motivation: 锥形光纤因色散可调和小模场面积而具高非线性，适合非线性与量子光学；四波混频的相位匹配强烈依赖色散，故锥径是关键参数，但亚微米锥的精确直径测量十分困难。
AI.method: 以宽谱光作种子注入锥形光纤，激发受激四波混频产生梳状光谱；建立包含沿光纤长度累积相位的联合谱振幅（joint-spectral amplitude）模型，将梳状光谱与整体锥形轮廓联系起来。
AI.result: 梳状光谱直接对应于锥形轮廓，从而能够无损地评估亚微米锥形光纤的直径分布。
AI.conclusion: 宽谱种子受激四波混频产生的梳状光谱可作为非破坏性表征手段，用于亚微米锥形光纤直径的无损检测。

title: Optical vortex bullets with large angular momenta
comment: 8 pages, 10 figures. To be published in Photonics and Quantum Waves (PQW)
summary: We investigate three-dimensional spatiotemporal optical vortex solitons (light bullets with a toroidal shape) carrying higher-order orbital angular momentum in Kerr media with anomalous group-velocity dispersion and a transversely localized Gaussian profile of the linear refractive index. Stationary vortex bullets with topological charges (winding numbers) $1\leq \ell \leq 4$ are obtained as numerical solutions of the three-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger equation, and their existence, structure and stability are systematically analyzed. In terms of atomic Bose-Einstein condensates, these solutions represent matter-wave solitons with embedded vorticity. We examine the dependence of the solution families on the propagation constant, the depth and width of the guiding profile, and $\ell $. It is found that the increase of $\ell $ requires one to use a stronger or wider waveguiding potential to sustain localized states satisfying the Vakhitov-Kolokolov (VK) stability criterion. VK-complying and non-complying branches of vortex-soliton families are separated by a degenerate Townes branch. Direct simulations reveal that, although the guiding profile substantially suppresses the collapse and extends the propagation distance of vortex bullets, their robustness is ultimately limited by azimuthal instabilities, whose growth is enhanced for values of $\ell $. These results demonstrate that engineered refractive-index landscapes significantly enlarge the stability domain of spatiotemporal vortex bullets and provide guidelines for supporting optical bullets carrying large orbital angular momenta.

AI.tldr: 研究Kerr介质中携带高阶轨道角动量（拓扑荷1≤ℓ≤4）的三维时空光涡旋子弹，在反常群速度色散与横向局域高斯型线性折射率分布下的存在性、结构与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 探究能否通过工程化折射率（波导）势来扩大携带高阶轨道角动量的时空光涡旋孤子的稳定域，并给出支撑大角动量光子弹的设计准则。
AI.method: 将问题归结为三维非线性薛定谔方程，数值求解得到拓扑荷1≤ℓ≤4的稳态涡旋子弹解（亦可对应含内禀涡旋的原子BEC物质波孤子）；系统分析解族对传播常数、导引势深度与宽度及ℓ的依赖；用Vakhitov-Kolokolov判据划分稳定分支，并结合直接演化模拟考察方位不稳定性与坍缩行为。
AI.result: 增大ℓ需要更强或更宽的导引势才能维持满足VK判据的局域态；满足与不满足VK判据的解族分支由退化的Townes分支分隔；导引势显著抑制坍缩并延长传播距离，但鲁棒性最终受方位不稳定性限制，且该不稳定性随ℓ增大而增强。
AI.conclusion: 工程化折射率分布景观可显著扩大时空涡旋子弹的稳定域，为承载大轨道角动量的光子弹提供设计指导。

title: Self-Oscillating Photonic Frequency Comb for Sub-THz Local Oscillator Generation in Earth Observation Systems
summary: Earth observation missions rely on microwave and sub-terahertz radiometry for retrieving atmospheric parameters such as temperature, humidity, and cloud properties, with the 183- and 229-GHz spectral regions being particularly relevant. Local-oscillator (LO) generation at these frequencies requires low phase noise and high frequency stability while meeting stringent size, weight, and power (SWaP) constraints. Conventional architectures employ dielectric resonator oscillators followed by cascaded frequency-multiplication stages, requiring dedicated generation chains for different frequency bands and increasing hardware complexity. Furthermore, frequency multiplication degrades the phase noise of the generated signal. This work proposes and numerically investigates a reconfigurable self-oscillating microwave photonic architecture for LO generation in Earth observation receivers. Cascaded Mach-Zehnder and phase modulation within an optoelectronic feedback loop generate an optical frequency comb with enhanced higher-order components. A combination of optical filters is used to select the required comb line. First, a conventional bandpass filter with a bandwidth of approximately 10 GHz isolates the spectral region containing the desired component, after which a narrowband dual cavity Bragg grating ring resonator (BGRR) with a bandwidth of approximately 3 MHz provides the final line selection. The selected comb line is then combined with an optical reference derived from the same laser and photodetected to generate the desired millimeter-wave or sub-terahertz signal through optical heterodyning. Numerical simulations are presented for 183- and 229-GHz generation, demonstrating the ability of the same underlying architecture to address multiple LO frequencies by tuning the OEO electrical filter to the appropriate oscillation frequency and selecting the corresponding comb order.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并数值研究了一种可重构自振荡微波光子架构，用于地球观测接收机183/229 GHz本振生成：利用级联MZM与相位调制构建高阶增强的光频梳，经粗/精两级光滤波选线后与同源光参考拍频，实现可调的本振信号。
AI.motivation: 地球观测任务依赖183 GHz与229 GHz微波/亚太赫兹辐射计反演大气温湿与云参数，其本振需低相噪、高频率稳定度且满足严苛SWaP约束。传统介质谐振振荡器加级联倍频方案需为不同频段配备专用链路，硬件复杂且倍频会恶化相噪。
AI.method: 在光电反馈环路中串联马赫-曾德尔调制与相位调制，生成高阶分量增强的光频梳；先用约10 GHz带宽带通滤波器粗选目标谱区，再用约3 MHz窄带双腔布拉格光栅环形谐振器（BGRR）精选单根梳线；所选梳线与同一激光器导出的光参考合束、光电探测，经光外差产生毫米波/亚太赫兹信号；通过将OEO电滤波器调谐至相应振荡频率并选择对应梳阶实现重构。
AI.result: 数值仿真给出183 GHz与229 GHz的本振生成结果，表明同一底层架构仅通过调谐OEO电滤波器频率与选取相应梳阶即可覆盖多个本振频点。
AI.conclusion: 该可重构自振荡微波光子架构可替代多频段专用倍频链，在满足SWaP约束的同时避免倍频带来的相噪恶化，为地球观测辐射计提供多频点本振生成的统一方案。

title: Parameter-efficient neural computing with programmable photonic meshes
summary: Memory capacity and bandwidth are becoming major constraints in neural-network computing, motivating parameter-efficient representations that reduce model storage and data movement. Tensor-network methods already enable substantial compression of neural networks, but their structured operations are often poorly matched to conventional processors optimized for dense linear algebra. Such representations can be implemented in photonic hardware, although this typically requires optical architectures tailored to a particular factorization. Here we propose a different approach based on programmable photonic meshes. Compact electronic parameters determine the interferometer phases, while optical interference produces a dense, generally high-rank transformation. Since the parameterization remains electronic, its dimensionality and structure can be changed without modifying the optical circuit. Numerical experiments in end-to-end training demonstrate that the proposed photonic layers match or outperform strongly compressed tensor-train and brickwork layers, often with fewer trainable parameters. Experiments in parameter-efficient fine-tuning of a language model also show advantages over established digital adapters. The reduced trainable state lowers persistent memory requirements and offers the potential to reduce data movement and bandwidth demands.

AI.tldr: 提出基于可编程光子网格的神经网络参数高效表示，用紧凑电子参数控制干涉相位，由光学干涉产生稠密高秩变换，在端到端训练与语言模型微调中优于张量列/砖墙层及数字适配器。
AI.motivation: 神经网络中存储容量与带宽成为主要瓶颈，需要参数高效的表示以减少模型存储和数据移动；张量网络方法虽能压缩网络，但其结构化算子与面向稠密线性代数优化的传统处理器匹配不佳，而现有光子实现通常需针对特定分解定制光学架构。
AI.method: 以可编程光子网格为基础：由紧凑的电子参数决定干涉仪相位，光学干涉则产生稠密、一般为高秩的变换；由于参数化保留在电子域，其维度和结构可在不修改光路的情况下改变。
AI.result: 端到端训练数值实验显示，所提光子层达到或超过强压缩的张量列层与砖墙层，且常使用更少可训练参数；在语言模型参数高效微调实验中亦优于既有数字适配器。
AI.conclusion: 该光子层降低了可训练状态的持续内存需求，并有望减少数据移动与带宽压力。

title: Spatiotemporal spherical Gaussian pulses
summary: We describe a class of electromagnetic Gaussian modes with spherical spatiotemporal structure that remains invariant during propagation through anomalously dispersive media. The angular profile of the modes is given by spherical harmonics, whose quantization axis can be freely chosen. As a result, the modes support spatiotemporal orbital angular momentum (OAM) configurations with longitudinal and transverse components set by the orientation of the quantization axis. Superpositions of these modes generalize the familiar solution of a chirped pulse that simultaneously focuses and compresses to arbitrary angular structure. The modes are derived through a series of unitary transformations that map the dispersive paraxial wave equation onto a Schrödinger equation with a 3D isotropic harmonic potential. These transformations facilitate the identification of conserved operators for mixed longitudinal and transverse OAM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一类具有球状时空结构、在反常色散介质中传播时保持不变的电磁高斯模式。其角向轮廓由球谐函数给出，量化轴可任意选取，从而实现纵向与横向分量由量化轴取向决定的时空轨道角动量（OAM）构型；其叠加推广了啁啾脉冲同时聚焦与压缩的解。模式通过一系列酉变换导出，将色散傍轴波动方程映射为具有三维各向同性谐振势的薛定谔方程，并借此识别混合纵/横向OAM的守恒算符。
AI.motivation: 现有电磁模式（如高斯、拉盖尔-高斯等）在色散介质中传播时时空结构易发生畸变，且OAM通常受限于单一的纵向或横向分量。作者希望构造在反常色散介质中传播保持形状不变、并可灵活调控时空OAM构型的模式。
AI.method: 引入球状时空结构的电磁高斯模式，角向部分采用球谐函数（量化轴可任意选择）；通过一系列酉变换将色散傍轴波动方程映射为具有三维各向同性谐振势的薛定谔方程，据此导出模式并识别混合纵向与横向OAM的守恒算符。
AI.result: 所构造的模式在反常色散介质中传播时保持时空结构不变；可获得纵向与横向分量由量化轴取向决定的时空OAM构型；模式叠加推广了啁啾脉冲同时聚焦与压缩的经典解至任意角向结构；并给出混合纵/横向OAM的守恒算符。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一类传播不变的球状时空电磁模式及相应的守恒量框架，为色散介质中时空OAM的自由调控与脉冲整形提供了理论与数学工具。

title: Single-Mode Laser Arrays with Size-Invariant Loss Discrimination
summary: In conventional coupled oscillator lattices and laser arrays, expanding the active volume inevitably causes spectral crowding and degrades spatial uniformity, posing a long-standing barrier to high-power single-mode operation. We uncover a dissipative selection mechanism in sparse star networks that decouples modal selectivity from lattice size constraints. By engineering dissipative auxiliary couplings between a central hub and N peripheral resonators, the system establishes an exact star-Laplacian symmetry. This enforces a target eigenstate that is immune to all lossy channels while maintaining equal amplitude across all main nodes. All competing eigenstates break this symmetry, driving the auxiliary loss and opening a persistent, size-independent modal loss gap that prevents multi-mode competition. Realistic microring simulations validate the robustness of this dark-state isolation under electromagnetic dispersion and mechanism extension to arbitrary arrays is allowed when meets the system's exceptional point. By exploiting graph topology to bypass multi-mode competition, this work establishes a general route toward scalable high-power single-supermode laser arrays and robust state selection in coupled non-Hermitian systems.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示稀疏星形网络中的耗散选择机制，使模态选择性与晶格尺寸解耦，可实现尺寸无关的单模高功率激光阵列。
AI.motivation: 传统耦合振子晶格与激光阵列在扩大有源体积时不可避免地出现光谱拥挤与空间均匀性退化，长期制约高功率单模运行。
AI.method: 在中心hub与N个外围谐振器之间引入耗散性辅助耦合，构造精确的星形拉普拉斯对称性，使目标本征态对全部有损通道免疫并保持各主节点等幅；竞争本征态破坏该对称性而承受辅助损耗，形成与尺寸无关的持续模态损耗间隙。并以实际微环仿真验证色散下的鲁棒性及在满足奇异点条件下向任意阵列的推广。
AI.result: 形成尺寸无关的恒定模态损耗间隙，抑制多模竞争；微环仿真表明该暗态隔离在电磁色散下依然稳健，且机制可扩展至任意阵列（需满足系统奇异点条件）。
AI.conclusion: 借助图拓扑绕过模式竞争，为可扩展的高功率单一超模激光阵列及耦合非厄米系统中的鲁棒态选择提供了通用路径。
